Gladiator.name: Gladiator
Gladiator.source: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, pp. 44–46

Melee Duelist.source: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, pp. 46–47; official errata

rules.name: Accelerated Strike
rules.description: Compress an otherwise time-consuming series of attacks into a standard action once each encounter.

mechanics.use: Once per encounter, declare when taking a full attack.
mechanics.cost: Standard action instead of the full-round action normally required.
mechanics.effect: Resolve your full attack, including every attack you are entitled to make.
mechanics.special: Every weapon used in that full attack must be one with which you are proficient. Jedi and Soldiers may select this as a class bonus feat.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 32

rules.name: Acrobatic Strike
rules.description: Turn a successful tumble past an enemy into a more accurate immediate attack.

mechanics.trigger: You successfully tumble to avoid an attack of opportunity from a foe.
mechanics.effect: Gain +2 competence on your next attack against that foe.
mechanics.duration: The qualifying attack must occur before the end of your current turn.
mechanics.special: Jedi bonus feat.

rules.name: Armor Proficiency (Heavy)
rules.description: Use heavy armor without its severe nonproficiency penalties and activate its equipment bonuses.

mechanics.effect: Remove the -10 nonproficiency penalty from attack rolls and Acrobatics, Climb, Endurance, Initiative, Jump, Stealth, and Swim checks; gain the armor's special equipment bonuses.
mechanics.special: Scout and Soldier bonus feat. The Core feat lists no lower armor proficiency prerequisite.

rules.name: Armor Proficiency (Light)
rules.description: Use light armor without its nonproficiency penalties and activate its equipment bonuses.

mechanics.effect: Remove the -2 nonproficiency penalty from attack rolls and Acrobatics, Climb, Endurance, Initiative, Jump, Stealth, and Swim checks; gain the armor's special equipment bonuses.
mechanics.special: Noble, Scout, and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Armor Proficiency (Medium)
rules.description: Use medium armor without its nonproficiency penalties and activate its equipment bonuses.

mechanics.effect: Remove the -5 nonproficiency penalty from attack rolls and Acrobatics, Climb, Endurance, Initiative, Jump, Stealth, and Swim checks; gain the armor's special equipment bonuses.
mechanics.special: Scout and Soldier bonus feat. The Core feat lists no lower armor proficiency prerequisite.

rules.name: Bantha Rush
rules.description: Shove an enemy after landing a melee attack.

mechanics.use: Free action after a successful melee attack.
mechanics.target: The creature hit, no more than one size category larger than you.
mechanics.effect: Move the target 1 square in any direction.
mechanics.special: Cannot move a grabbed or grappled target, place it in another creature's space, or force it into a solid object. Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Burst Fire
rules.description: Concentrate autofire on one target for increased weapon damage.

special: Weapon must have autofire and at least 5 shots remaining

mechanics.use: Make one attack against one target while the weapon is set to autofire.
mechanics.cost: Spend 5 shots and take -5 on the attack roll; with a non-vehicle weapon and Strength below 13, take -10 instead.
mechanics.effect: On a hit, add two weapon-damage dice.
mechanics.special: Does not stack with Deadeye or Rapid Shot. Works with autofire-capable vehicle weapons.

rules.name: Careful Shot
rules.description: Gain extra accuracy after aiming a ranged weapon.

mechanics.trigger: You complete the aim action before making a ranged attack.
mechanics.effect: Gain +1 on the aimed attack roll.
mechanics.special: Scout and Soldier bonus feat. A vehicle pilot normally must split the two-swift-action aim and standard-action attack across turns because piloting consumes a move action.

rules.name: Charging Fire
rules.description: Replace the melee strike at the end of a charge with a ranged attack.

mechanics.use: Charge normally, then make one ranged attack at the end of the movement.
mechanics.effect: The ranged attack receives no +2 charge bonus.
mechanics.duration: You take the charge's -2 Reflex Defense penalty until the start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: All other charge restrictions apply. Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Cleave
rules.description: Follow a killing melee blow with an immediate strike against another reachable enemy.

mechanics.use: Immediate extra melee attack, at most once per round.
mechanics.trigger: Your melee attack reduces an opponent to 0 hit points.
mechanics.target: A different opponent within your reach.
mechanics.effect: Attack with the same weapon and the same attack bonus used for the triggering blow.
mechanics.special: Jedi and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Combat Reflexes
rules.description: Make several attacks of opportunity each round and respond even while flat-footed.

mechanics.effect: Gain additional attacks of opportunity each round equal to your Dexterity modifier, beyond the normal one, and you may make attacks of opportunity while flat-footed.
mechanics.special: You still cannot make more than one attack of opportunity against the same opponent for the same provoking action. Jedi and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Conditioning
rules.description: Superior conditioning improves trained physical skills and can briefly reinforce your Fortitude Defense.

mechanics.use: Reroll applicable checks whenever made; defensive use is a reaction once per encounter.
mechanics.trigger: A Strength- or Constitution-based check with a skill in which you are trained, or an effect against Fortitude Defense.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll the qualifying trained skill check, but must accept the second result. For the defensive use, add your Strength bonus to Fortitude Defense.
mechanics.duration: The Fortitude bonus lasts until the beginning of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Scout and Soldier bonus feat.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 32

rules.name: Coordinated Attack
rules.description: Automatically succeed when aiding an ally's attack or suppressing a nearby enemy.

mechanics.use: Aid another on an attack or suppression attempt.
mechanics.target: A target adjacent to you or within your point-blank range.
mechanics.effect: The aid attempt succeeds automatically; no attack roll against Reflex 10 is required.
mechanics.special: Soldier bonus feat. In vehicle combat it can aid attacks, including qualifying sensor-operator or commander aid, but cannot suppress a vehicle; an individual gunner can be suppressed.

rules.name: Critical Strike
rules.description: Spend time lining up a melee blow to expand its critical threat range.

feats: Weapon Focus (selected melee weapon or weapon group)
special: Proficient with the melee weapon used

mechanics.use: Take two consecutive swift actions in one round before the attack.
mechanics.target: The target of your next melee attack.
mechanics.effect: Increase the critical range of that next melee attack by 1; normally this means a natural 19 or 20 can be a critical hit.
mechanics.special: A natural 19 is not an automatic hit: it must still equal or exceed Reflex Defense. The setup is lost if you take another action or lose line of sight before attacking. Jedi and Soldier bonus feat.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 32

rules.name: Crush
rules.description: Damage an opponent immediately after pinning it in a grapple.

mechanics.trigger: You successfully pin an opponent with a grapple attack.
mechanics.effect: Immediately deal bludgeoning damage equal to your unarmed damage or claw damage, whichever is higher.
mechanics.special: Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Cybernetic Surgery
rules.description: Install a cybernetic prosthesis through surgery.

mechanics.use: 1 hour of uninterrupted surgery, followed by Treat Injury DC 20.
mechanics.target: One living creature receiving a cybernetic prosthesis.
mechanics.effect: Success installs the prosthesis correctly; failure does not install it, but another attempt may be made after another hour.
mechanics.special: Operating on yourself imposes -5. Surgical Expertise reduces installation time to 10 minutes. Noble bonus feat.

rules.name: Deadeye
rules.description: An aimed ranged hit deals one additional weapon die.

mechanics.trigger: You aim before a ranged attack and the attack hits.
mechanics.effect: Add one weapon-damage die.
mechanics.special: Does not stack with Burst Fire or Rapid Shot. Scoundrel, Scout, and Soldier bonus feat. Vehicle pilots may use it but usually must aim and attack on separate turns.

rules.name: Dodge
rules.description: Gain a +1 dodge bonus to Reflex Defense against attacks from one designated opponent; you can change the designated opponent on your turn.

rules.name: Double Attack
rules.description: Make one additional attack with a chosen weapon group during a full attack.

special: Proficient with the selected exotic weapon or weapon group

mechanics.use: Full attack with the selected weapon.
mechanics.effect: Make one additional attack.
mechanics.duration: All your attack rolls take -5 until the start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Select one exotic weapon or advanced melee, heavy, lightsaber, pistol, rifle, or simple weapon group. May be taken again for another selection. Heavy Weapons selection works with vehicle weapons. Jedi and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Dreadful Rage
rules.description: Increase the offensive bonus granted by a species rage.

mechanics.effect: Your rage bonus on melee attack and melee damage rolls becomes +5 instead of the normal +2.
mechanics.special: Does not grant rage or additional daily uses by itself.

rules.name: Dual Weapon Mastery I
rules.description: Reduce the penalty for full attacks with two weapons or both ends of a double weapon.

mechanics.use: Full attack with two proficient weapons or both ends of a proficient double weapon.
mechanics.effect: All attacks take -5 instead of the normal -10.
mechanics.duration: Penalty lasts until the start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Does not apply to vehicle weapons. Jedi and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Dual Weapon Mastery II
rules.description: Further reduce the penalty for two-weapon or double-weapon full attacks.

mechanics.use: Full attack with two proficient weapons or both ends of a proficient double weapon.
mechanics.effect: All attacks take -2 instead of -10.
mechanics.duration: Penalty lasts until the start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Does not apply to vehicle weapons. Jedi and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Dual Weapon Mastery III
rules.description: Eliminate the standard penalty for two-weapon or double-weapon full attacks.

mechanics.use: Full attack with two proficient weapons or both ends of a proficient double weapon.
mechanics.effect: Make the attacks with no two-weapon full-attack penalty.
mechanics.special: Does not apply to vehicle weapons. Jedi and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Echani Training
rules.description: An Echani fighting style that rewards a single committed unarmed strike and can sweep an opponent from their feet.

mechanics.use: Passive damage benefit when making only one unarmed attack during the turn; the knockdown attempt is a free action once per encounter after dealing unarmed damage.
mechanics.target: A creature no more than one size category larger than you.
mechanics.check: Make an immediate unarmed attack roll against the target's Fortitude Defense.
mechanics.effect: For the single-attack benefit, double the damage contribution from your Strength bonus, with at least +1 Strength-derived damage. If the follow-up attack beats Fortitude, knock the target prone in its current square.
mechanics.special: Fortitude gains +5 Large, +10 Huge, +20 Gargantuan, or +50 Colossal; an unusually stable target gains another +5.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 33

rules.name: Exotic Weapon Proficiency
rules.description: Become proficient with one chosen exotic weapon.

mechanics.use: Choose one exotic weapon when taking the feat.
mechanics.effect: Use that weapon without the normal -5 nonproficiency penalty.
mechanics.special: May be selected repeatedly for different exotic weapons. Noble and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Extra Rage
rules.description: Use a species rage one additional time each day.

mechanics.effect: Gain one additional daily use of rage.
mechanics.special: May be taken repeatedly; each selection adds another daily use.

rules.name: Extra Second Wind
rules.description: Gain another daily second wind without changing the once-per-encounter limit.

mechanics.effect: Gain one additional use of second wind per day.
mechanics.special: Still only one second wind per encounter. A nonheroic character's first selection grants one daily second wind. Repeatable for additional daily uses.

rules.name: Far Shot
rules.description: Treat ranged targets as one range category nearer for attack penalties.

mechanics.effect: Short range has no penalty, medium is -2, and long is -5, replacing the normal -2/-5/-10 penalties.
mechanics.special: Works with vehicle weapons. A missed missile or torpedo does not retain this benefit for its later attack roll. Scout and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Flurry
rules.description: Trade defense for a burst of accuracy with light melee weapons or lightsabers.

mechanics.use: Declare while wielding only light weapons or lightsabers.
mechanics.effect: Gain +2 on melee attack rolls and take -5 to Reflex Defense.
mechanics.duration: Both modifiers last until the start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: May substitute for Point Blank Shot when qualifying for Elite Trooper. Jedi, Noble, and Soldier bonus feat.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 33

rules.name: Follow Through
rules.description: After dropping an enemy in melee, carry your momentum across the battlefield.

mechanics.trigger: A melee attack reduces an opponent to 0 hit points.
mechanics.effect: Immediately move up to your speed, once per turn.
mechanics.special: With Cleave, you may make this movement before the extra Cleave attack.

rules.name: Force Boon
rules.description: Increase the Force Points received whenever you gain a level.

mechanics.effect: Gain 3 additional Force Points at every character level.
mechanics.special: Destiny's Jedi-level story gate applies.

rules.name: Force Readiness
rules.description: Your Force Points are available even when an effect occurs outside your own turn.

mechanics.use: Free action, including when it is not your turn.
mechanics.effect: You may spend Force Points outside your turn, allowing them to modify eligible attacks, checks, reactions, or abilities made then.
mechanics.special: This changes timing only; every normal limit on spending Force Points still applies. Jedi bonus feat. Destiny's Jedi-level story gate applies.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 33

rules.name: Force Regimen Mastery
rules.description: Learn structured Force-training regimens that provide benefits after successful practice.

mechanics.effect: Learn Force regimens equal to 1 + Wisdom modifier, minimum 1.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for the same number of additional regimens. A permanent Wisdom-modifier increase adds one regimen per instance of this feat.

rules.name: Force Sensitivity
rules.description: You become Force-sensitive, gain access to Use the Force, and may select Force talents when otherwise eligible. Destiny additionally requires Jedi 1+ before this option is available.

source.name: Saga Edition RPG Omnibus — Force Sensitivity

rules.name: Force Training
rules.description: Add Force powers to your suite equal to 1 + your Wisdom modifier, minimum 1. The feat can be taken repeatedly, adding another set each time.

source.name: Saga Edition RPG Omnibus — Force Training

rules.name: Gearhead
rules.description: Once per encounter, complete a Mechanics or Use Computer task one action category faster.

mechanics.use: Once per encounter when beginning a Mechanics or Use Computer check.
mechanics.effect: Full-round becomes standard; standard becomes move; move becomes swift; a task requiring multiple swift actions costs one fewer swift action.
mechanics.special: A task longer than one round takes half its normal time instead, but the check suffers -10. Scoundrel and Scout bonus feat.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 33

rules.name: Great Cleave
rules.description: Use Cleave repeatedly in the same round as long as your melee attacks continue dropping opponents.

mechanics.trigger: A melee attack reduces an opponent to 0 hit points.
mechanics.effect: Use Cleave without its once-per-round limit, making another same-weapon, same-bonus attack against a different opponent within reach after each qualifying takedown.
mechanics.special: Each extra attack must itself meet Cleave's normal targeting requirements. Jedi and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Implant Training
rules.description: Your body has adapted to a cybernetic implant, removing its additional condition-track vulnerability.

mechanics.use: Always active while you possess the implant.
mechanics.effect: When an effect moves you down the condition track, the implant no longer causes you to move one additional step.
mechanics.special: This removes the implant's extra step; it does not prevent the normal condition movement caused by the triggering effect. Scoundrel bonus feat.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 33

rules.name: Improved Charge
rules.description: Change direction during a charge to navigate around obstacles.

mechanics.effect: Your charge need not follow a straight line; you may alter direction around obstacles.
mechanics.special: Every other charge restriction and modifier still applies. Jedi and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Improved Damage Threshold
rules.description: Become harder to move down the condition track through heavy damage.

mechanics.effect: Increase Damage Threshold by 5.
mechanics.special: Repeatable; bonuses stack, adding another +5 each time.

rules.name: Improved Defenses
rules.description: Gain a permanent increase to all three personal Defenses.

mechanics.effect: Gain +1 Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Defense.
mechanics.special: Does not increase a vehicle's Defenses while you pilot or command it.

rules.name: Improved Disarm
rules.description: Disarm more accurately and avoid the normal retaliation after failure.

mechanics.use: When making a melee disarm attack.
mechanics.effect: Gain +5 on the attack roll. If the disarm fails, the opponent does not receive the normal free attack against you.
mechanics.special: Jedi and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Improved Rapid Strike
rules.description: A more forceful Rapid Strike with a light melee weapon or lightsaber.

special: Use a light melee weapon or lightsaber

mechanics.use: Choose when making a Rapid Strike with a light melee weapon or lightsaber.
mechanics.cost: Take -5 on the attack roll, or -10 if Dexterity is below 13.
mechanics.effect: On a hit, add two weapon-damage dice.
mechanics.special: Does not stack with ordinary Rapid Strike bonus damage or another extra-damage option that itself cannot stack with Rapid Strike, such as Mighty Swing. Jedi and Soldier bonus feat.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 33

rules.name: Increased Agility
rules.description: Move farther while climbing, swimming, or jumping and defend normally while climbing.

mechanics.effect: Increase Climb speed, Swim speed, and Jump distance by 2 squares. Retain your Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense while climbing.
mechanics.special: Scout and Soldier bonus feat.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 33

rules.name: Linguist
rules.description: Learn several additional spoken languages.

mechanics.effect: Learn a number of bonus languages equal to 1 + Intelligence modifier, minimum 1.
mechanics.special: Repeatable; determine the number gained from the current Intelligence modifier each time. Noble and Scout bonus feat.

rules.name: Logic Upgrade: Self Defense
rules.description: A droid defensive subroutine that reinforces one defense at the moment it is needed.

mechanics.effect: Choose Fortitude, Reflex, or Will Defense and gain a +2 morale bonus to that Defense.
mechanics.duration: Until the end of your next turn.
mechanics.special: The defense is chosen each time the feat is activated.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 34

rules.name: Logic Upgrade: Tactician
rules.description: A droid tactical routine makes one assisted attack far more accurate.

mechanics.use: Once per encounter when using aid another to assist an ally's attack.
mechanics.target: One ally making its next attack against the opponent you helped against.
mechanics.effect: A successful aid another grants +5 to that attack instead of the normal +2.
mechanics.special: All normal requirements for aiding another on an attack still apply.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 34

rules.name: Long Haft Strike
rules.description: Use both ends of an oversized lightsaber as a double weapon.

mechanics.effect: A lightsaber pike or long-handle lightsaber may be used as a double weapon, following that weapon's individual double-weapon profile.

rules.name: Mandalorian Training
rules.description: Improve a ranged charge and harden your resolve after committing to it.

mechanics.effect: Gain +2 on the ranged attack made at the end of the charge and +2 morale to Will Defense.
mechanics.duration: The Will bonus lasts until the beginning of your next turn.
mechanics.special: You still take the normal -2 Reflex Defense penalty for charging.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 34

rules.name: Martial Arts I
rules.description: Improve unarmed damage and gain a dodge bonus to Reflex Defense.

mechanics.effect: Increase unarmed damage one die step (1d3 to 1d4, 1d4 to 1d6, or 1d6 to 1d8) and gain +1 dodge to Reflex Defense.
mechanics.special: Jedi and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Martial Arts II
rules.description: Further improve unarmed damage and the Martial Arts dodge bonus.

mechanics.effect: Increase unarmed damage another die step (1d4 to 1d6, 1d6 to 1d8, or 1d8 to 1d10); the Martial Arts dodge bonus to Reflex becomes +2 total.
mechanics.special: The Reflex bonuses from Martial Arts ranks replace rather than add to one another. Jedi and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Martial Arts III
rules.description: Reach the highest Core tier of unarmed damage and defense.

mechanics.effect: Increase unarmed damage another die step (1d6 to 1d8, 1d8 to 1d10, or 1d10 to 1d12); the Martial Arts dodge bonus to Reflex becomes +3 total.
mechanics.special: The Reflex bonuses from Martial Arts ranks replace rather than add to one another. Jedi and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Melee Defense
rules.description: Trade melee accuracy for a larger dodge bonus to Reflex Defense.

mechanics.use: When using a standard action to make a melee attack.
mechanics.cost: Choose an attack penalty from -1 to -5, not exceeding your base attack bonus.
mechanics.effect: Gain an equal dodge bonus to Reflex Defense.
mechanics.duration: Both modifiers last until the start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Without this feat, fighting defensively is normally -5 attack for only +2 Reflex. Jedi, Noble, Scoundrel, and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Mighty Swing
rules.description: Spend two swift actions preparing a harder melee hit.

mechanics.use: Take two swift actions in the same round before your next melee attack that round.
mechanics.effect: If the attack hits, add one weapon-damage die.
mechanics.special: Does not stack with Rapid Strike bonus damage. Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Mobility
rules.description: Improve your defense against opportunistic attacks caused by movement.

mechanics.use: Passive while moving into or out of threatened areas.
mechanics.effect: Gain +5 dodge to Reflex Defense against attacks of opportunity provoked by that movement.
mechanics.special: Lost whenever you lose your Dexterity bonus to Reflex; dodge bonuses stack. Jedi, Scoundrel, and Scout bonus feat.

rules.name: Pin
rules.description: Immobilize an opponent after winning a grapple.

mechanics.trigger: Your grappling attack succeeds and the opponent loses the opposed grapple check.
mechanics.effect: The opponent is pinned: it cannot move or act and loses its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense.
mechanics.duration: Until the start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Cannot use Pin and Trip in the same round; Pin and Crush may be combined. Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Point Blank Shot
rules.description: Gain +1 on ranged attack and damage rolls against targets within point-blank range.

source.name: Saga Edition RPG Omnibus — Point Blank Shot

rules.name: Poison Resistance
rules.description: Resist poisonous attacks and reduce their damage when resistance fails.

mechanics.effect: Gain +5 Fortitude Defense against poison. If the poison attack still succeeds, take half of its damage.
mechanics.special: Scoundrel and Scout bonus feat.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 34

rules.name: Power Attack
rules.description: Trade melee accuracy for damage.

mechanics.cost: Choose a penalty no greater than your base attack bonus and apply it to all melee attacks.
mechanics.effect: Add the same number to melee damage; with a two-handed weapon, or a one-handed weapon held in two hands, add twice that number.
mechanics.duration: Until the start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Bonus damage does not apply against objects or vehicles. Jedi and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Power Blast
rules.description: Trade ranged accuracy for an equal increase in ranged damage.

mechanics.use: Swift action before making ranged attacks.
mechanics.cost: Choose an attack penalty no greater than your base attack bonus.
mechanics.effect: Apply the chosen penalty to all ranged attack rolls and the same number as a bonus to all qualifying ranged damage rolls.
mechanics.duration: Until the start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: No bonus damage on area attacks or attacks against objects or vehicles. With a non-vehicle weapon and Strength below 13, the attack penalty is fixed at -5. Soldier bonus feat.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 34

rules.name: Powerful Charge
rules.description: Hit harder at the end of a melee charge.

mechanics.use: When making the melee attack at the end of a charge.
mechanics.effect: Gain an additional +2 attack beyond the normal charge modifier; on a hit add damage equal to half your character level.
mechanics.special: Jedi bonus feat.

rules.name: Precise Shot
rules.description: Fire into melee without the usual risk penalty.

mechanics.effect: Ignore the normal -5 ranged attack penalty for attacking an opponent engaged in melee with one or more of your allies.
mechanics.special: Scoundrel, Scout, and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Quick Draw
rules.description: Draw or holster weapons more quickly.

mechanics.effect: Draw or holster one weapon; this normally requires a move action.
mechanics.special: Jedi, Scoundrel, and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Quick Skill
rules.description: Once per encounter, rely on trained competence under pressure or complete a painstaking task in far less time.

mechanics.use: Once per encounter with a skill in which you are trained.
mechanics.effect: Either take 10 despite being rushed, or take 20 in half the time normally required.
mechanics.special: Cannot override a skill rule that expressly forbids taking 10. Taking 20 normally costs twenty times the standard check time. Noble and Scoundrel bonus feat.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 34

rules.name: Rapid Shot
rules.description: Fire twice as one ranged attack to add a weapon die of damage.

special: Proficient with the ranged weapon used

mechanics.use: Make one ranged attack against one target, expending two shots.
mechanics.cost: -2 attack, or -5 with a non-vehicle weapon if Strength is below 13.
mechanics.effect: On a hit, add one weapon-damage die.
mechanics.special: Does not stack with Burst Fire or Deadeye. Works with vehicle weapons; a missed missile or torpedo does not retain the benefit on its later attack. Scoundrel, Scout, and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Rapid Strike
rules.description: Make two quick melee strikes as one attack to add a weapon die of damage.

special: Proficient with the melee weapon used

mechanics.use: Make one melee attack against one target.
mechanics.cost: -2 attack; with a non-light weapon and Dexterity below 13, the penalty is -5.
mechanics.effect: On a hit, add one weapon-damage die.
mechanics.special: Does not stack with Mighty Swing. Bonus feat for every heroic class.

rules.name: Relentless Attack
rules.description: A missed attack improves your next attempt against the same target.

mechanics.selection: Choose a weapon group or exotic weapon for which you possess Double Attack.
mechanics.trigger: Miss a target with the selected weapon.
mechanics.effect: Gain +2 competence bonus on your next attack against that target made before the end of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for a different weapon group or exotic weapon.

rules.name: Republic Military Training
rules.description: Use cover to absorb the brunt of an incoming attack.

mechanics.trigger: You are targeted by an incoming attack and have cover from that attacker.
mechanics.effect: Gain DR 10 against the triggering attack.
mechanics.special: The feat still works if the attacker aimed to ignore the cover bonus to your Reflex Defense; actual cover must nevertheless exist.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 35

rules.name: Running Attack
rules.description: Split your movement around a melee or ranged attack.

mechanics.use: When attacking with a melee or ranged weapon.
mechanics.effect: Move before and after the attack, provided the total movement does not exceed your speed.
mechanics.special: Jedi, Scoundrel, Scout, and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Shake It Off
rules.description: Recover along the condition track with fewer swift actions.

mechanics.effect: Move +1 step toward normal on the condition track.
mechanics.special: Normally requires three swift actions; persistent conditions still prevent normal recovery. Scout and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Sith Military Training
rules.description: Turn a brutal takedown into a moment of fear that weakens nearby enemies.

mechanics.trigger: You reduce a target to 0 hit points or deal damage equal to or greater than its Damage Threshold.
mechanics.target: Every enemy within 6 squares of the triggering target.
mechanics.effect: Affected enemies take -2 to all Defenses.
mechanics.duration: Until the end of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting effect; immune creatures are unaffected.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 35

rules.name: Skill Focus
rules.description: Choose one trained skill; gain a +5 competence bonus on checks with that skill.

source.name: Saga Edition RPG Omnibus — Skill Focus

rules.name: Skill Training
rules.description: Choose an untrained skill from your class skill list; you become trained in that skill.

special: Selected skill must be a class skill and not already trained

source.name: Saga Edition RPG Omnibus — Skill Training

rules.name: Sniper
rules.description: Ignore cover supplied by creatures when making ranged attacks.

mechanics.effect: Always ignore soft cover from characters, creatures, or droids when making ranged attacks; no aim action is required.
mechanics.special: Does not ignore non-soft cover. Scout and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Sniper Shot
rules.description: Expose yourself to gain accuracy with a non-heavy ranged weapon.

special: Proficient with the ranged weapon used

mechanics.use: Declare while wielding only weapons with which you are proficient.
mechanics.effect: Gain +2 on your ranged attack and take -5 to Reflex Defense.
mechanics.duration: The Reflex penalty lasts until the beginning of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Cannot be used with heavy weapons or vehicle weapons. Scoundrel and Soldier bonus feat.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 35

rules.name: Strong in the Force
rules.description: Roll larger dice when spending Force Points on checks.

mechanics.trigger: Spend a Force Point to modify an attack roll, skill check, or ability check.
mechanics.effect: Roll d8s instead of d6s for the Force Point.
mechanics.special: Does not change Force Points spent for effects that do not roll Force dice. Jedi bonus feat; Destiny's Jedi-level story gate applies.

rules.name: Surgical Expertise
rules.description: Perform surgery in a fraction of the normal time.

mechanics.use: When performing surgery with Treat Injury.
mechanics.effect: The procedure takes 10 minutes instead of 1 hour.
mechanics.special: Also reduces Cybernetic Surgery installation time to 10 minutes. Noble bonus feat.

rules.name: Throw
rules.description: Hurl an opponent after tripping it during a grapple.

mechanics.trigger: You successfully use Trip during a grapple.
mechanics.target: The tripped opponent.
mechanics.effect: Place it prone in any unoccupied space up to 1 square beyond your reach and deal bludgeoning damage equal to your unarmed attack damage.
mechanics.special: The thrown opponent is no longer grappled. Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Toughness
rules.description: Gain additional hit points based on character level.

mechanics.effect: Increase maximum hit points by 1 per character level, including levels gained after taking the feat.
mechanics.special: Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Trip
rules.description: Knock an opponent prone after winning a grapple.

mechanics.trigger: Your grappling attack succeeds and the opponent loses the opposed grapple check.
mechanics.effect: The opponent falls prone in its current square and the grapple ends.
mechanics.special: Cannot use Trip and Pin in the same round. A prone creature takes -5 melee attack; melee attacks against it gain +5 and ranged attacks against it take -5. Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Triple Attack
rules.description: Add a third attack with a chosen weapon during a full attack.

feats: Double Attack (selected weapon or weapon group)
special: Proficient with the selected weapon or group

mechanics.use: Full attack with the selected exotic weapon or weapon group.
mechanics.effect: Make one additional attack; combined with Double Attack this produces two extra attacks total.
mechanics.cost: Triple Attack adds another -5 to every attack, stacking with Double Attack's -5 for -10 total.
mechanics.duration: Penalty lasts until your next turn.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for different selections; Heavy Weapons works with vehicle weapons. Jedi and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Triple Crit
rules.description: Deal triple rather than double damage on critical hits with one selected weapon.

mechanics.trigger: Score a critical hit with the selected weapon or unarmed attack.
mechanics.effect: Deal triple damage instead of the normal double damage.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for different specific weapons; effects do not stack. May apply to a specific vehicle weapon. Jedi and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Tumble Defense
rules.description: Make it harder for enemies to tumble safely through the area threatened by your melee weapon.

special: Proficient with the melee weapon used

mechanics.use: Passive while threatening squares with a melee weapon.
mechanics.trigger: An opponent attempts to tumble through a square you threaten.
mechanics.effect: Add your base attack bonus to the DC of the opponent's Acrobatics check. On a failed check, you may make the normal attack of opportunity.
mechanics.special: Does not function while you are flat-footed. Jedi and Soldier bonus feat.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 35

rules.name: Unswerving Resolve
rules.description: Resisting fear or mental domination produces a brief reserve of Force energy.

mechanics.trigger: A fear or mind-affecting effect targets you but fails to affect you.
mechanics.effect: Gain 1 temporary Force Point, lost if unused by the end of your next turn.
mechanics.special: You gain nothing if you actively negate the effect, such as with Rebuke.

rules.name: Vehicular Combat
rules.description: Avoid a weapon hit against a vehicle you pilot and operate pilot-controlled weapons proficiently.

mechanics.trigger: A weapon attack hits the vehicle or starship you are piloting.
mechanics.check: Pilot check against a DC equal to the triggering attack roll.
mechanics.effect: Success negates the weapon hit.
mechanics.special: While piloting, you are proficient with weapons designated as pilot-operated. Scoundrel, Scout, and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Weapon Finesse
rules.description: Use agility rather than strength to aim eligible melee attacks.

mechanics.use: When attacking with a light melee weapon or lightsaber.
mechanics.effect: Use Dexterity modifier instead of Strength modifier on the attack roll.
mechanics.special: Does not replace Strength for damage. Jedi and Noble bonus feat.

rules.name: Weapon Focus
rules.description: Gain accuracy with one exotic weapon or weapon group.

special: Proficient with selected weapon or group

mechanics.effect: Gain +1 on attack rolls with the selected exotic weapon or weapon group.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for different selections; bonuses do not stack on one weapon. Heavy Weapons applies to vehicle weapons. Jedi may select lightsabers as a bonus feat; Soldier may select any qualifying option.

rules.name: Weapon Proficiency (Advanced Melee Weapons)
rules.description: Use advanced melee weapons without a nonproficiency penalty.

mechanics.effect: Remove the normal -5 nonproficiency penalty with advanced melee weapons, including most powered melee weapons other than lightsabers.
mechanics.special: Does not cover exotic weapons. Noble, Scoundrel, Scout, and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Weapon Proficiency (Heavy Weapons)
rules.description: Use heavy weapons without a nonproficiency penalty.

mechanics.effect: Remove the normal -5 nonproficiency penalty with heavy weapons, including most mounted vehicle and starship weapons.
mechanics.special: Does not cover exotic weapons. Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Weapon Proficiency (Lightsabers)
rules.description: Use lightsabers and their variants without a nonproficiency penalty.

mechanics.effect: Remove the normal -5 nonproficiency penalty with lightsabers, including double-bladed lightsabers and lightwhips.
mechanics.special: Does not cover unrelated exotic weapons. Jedi bonus feat; Destiny's Jedi-level story gate applies.

rules.name: Weapon Proficiency (Pistols)
rules.description: Use pistols without a nonproficiency penalty.

mechanics.effect: Remove the normal -5 nonproficiency penalty with pistol-group weapons, including most one-handed blasters and slugthrowers.
mechanics.special: Does not cover exotic weapons. Noble, Scoundrel, Scout, and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Weapon Proficiency (Rifles)
rules.description: Use rifles without a nonproficiency penalty.

mechanics.effect: Remove the normal -5 nonproficiency penalty with rifle-group weapons, including most two-handed blaster rifles, carbines, and slugthrower rifles.
mechanics.special: Does not cover exotic weapons. Noble, Scoundrel, Scout, and Soldier bonus feat.

rules.name: Weapon Proficiency (Simple Weapons)
rules.description: Use simple weapons without a nonproficiency penalty.

mechanics.effect: Remove the normal -5 nonproficiency penalty with simple weapons, including most nonpowered melee weapons, unarmed attacks, and thrown weapons.
mechanics.special: Does not cover exotic weapons. Bonus feat for all heroic classes.

rules.name: Whirlwind Attack
rules.description: Make one melee area attack against every target within reach.

mechanics.target: Every target within your melee reach.
mechanics.check: Make one melee attack roll and compare it with each target under the area-attack rules.
mechanics.effect: Resolve the weapon's damage against each target hit by that single area attack.
mechanics.special: Because it is an area attack, the normal area-attack resolution rules apply.

rules.name: Withdrawal Strike
rules.description: Prevent adjacent opponents from using the withdraw action safely against your chosen melee weapon family.

special: Proficient with the selected melee weapon or group

mechanics.use: Always active while wielding a melee weapon from the group or exotic weapon chosen when taking this feat.
mechanics.target: Adjacent opponents in squares you threaten.
mechanics.effect: Those opponents cannot use withdraw to leave your threatened squares.
mechanics.special: They may still attempt to tumble with Acrobatics. Select one exotic weapon or weapon group each time. Jedi and Soldier bonus feat.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 34

rules.name: Assured Strike
rules.description: Trade damage for an exceptionally accurate lightsaber strike.

mechanics.target: One enemy within reach
mechanics.effect: Make one lightsaber attack, roll twice and keep the higher result; damage penalty is -5/-2/-1/0.
mechanics.form: Juyo: if both attack rolls miss, the power remains in your suite.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to roll three attack rolls and keep the highest.

rules.name: Barrier of Blades
rules.description: Whirl your blade into a defensive screen against ranged attacks.

mechanics.target: You
mechanics.check: Use the Force check establishes defense
mechanics.effect: Use the check result in place of Reflex Defense against non-area ranged attacks until your next turn.
mechanics.form: Shien: redirect one blaster bolt that misses you as though using Redirect Shot.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to cover autofire; take half damage if hit and none if missed.

rules.name: Battle Strike
rules.description: Channel the Force into your next attack, improving its accuracy and potentially its damage based on your Use the Force result.

source.name: Saga Edition Core Rulebook — Force Powers

rules.name: Blind
rules.description: Hurl debris into a foe's senses, leaving it exposed and unable to see others clearly.

mechanics.target: One creature within 12 squares and line of sight
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. Reflex Defense
mechanics.effect: The target is flat-footed and all other creatures have concealment from it until the start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Creatures that do not rely on eyesight are immune. Spend a Force Point to activate as a free action.

rules.name: Circle of Shelter
rules.description: Create a defensive zone protecting you and adjacent allies.

mechanics.target: You and all adjacent allies
mechanics.effect: Gain +1/+2/+5 deflection bonus to Reflex Defense through the end of your next turn.
mechanics.form: Soresu: add the bonus to Use the Force checks for Block and Deflect.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to apply the bonus to adjacent allies' Fortitude Defense as well.

rules.name: Contentious Opportunity
rules.description: Exploit an opening to make a more damaging attack of opportunity.

mechanics.action: Free action when making an attack of opportunity
mechanics.target: One enemy within reach
mechanics.effect: If the opportunity attack hits, deal +1/+2/+3/+4 weapon-damage dice.
mechanics.form: Makashi: gain +2 Force bonus on attacks of opportunity through the end of your next turn.
mechanics.special: After a hit, spend a Force Point to reduce target speed by 2 squares through its next turn.

rules.name: Convection
rules.description: Superheat your body so your unarmed attacks burn and ignite their targets.

mechanics.action: Swift action; swift action each round to maintain
mechanics.target: You
mechanics.effect: Until the start of your next turn, unarmed melee attacks deal +1d6/+2d6/+3d6/+4d6 fire damage and damaged targets catch fire.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point so creatures striking you unarmed or attempting a grab/grapple also take the bonus damage. Recheck each maintained round; damage requires a DC 15 + damage check to continue.

rules.name: Crucitorn
rules.description: Endure a single traumatic attack without yielding to pain.

mechanics.action: Reaction to an attack or Force power
mechanics.target: You
mechanics.effect: Gain +5/+10/+15/+20 Force bonus to Damage Threshold against the triggering damage.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to increase the bonus by another +5.

rules.name: Cryokinesis
rules.description: Drain heat from an unattended object, weakening its structure and disabling its systems.

mechanics.action: Standard action; swift action to maintain
mechanics.target: One unattended object within 12 squares and line of sight
mechanics.effect: Reduce DR by 5/10/15/20 through the end of your next turn; a mechanical or electronic object also moves -1 condition step.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point for another -5 DR. At the bottom of the track the object stops functioning until repaired. Maintaining extends DR loss but causes no further condition movement.

rules.name: Dark Rage
rules.description: Draw on anger to gain a temporary Force bonus on melee attack and damage rolls; using it is a dark-side act.

source.name: Saga Edition Core Rulebook — Force Powers

rules.name: Deflecting Slash
rules.description: Turn aside a ranged attack and slash an enemy within reach.

mechanics.action: Reaction when targeted by a non-area ranged attack
mechanics.target: You and one enemy within reach
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. incoming attack; DC 20/25/30 adds +1/+3/+5 damage
mechanics.effect: Success halves incoming damage on a hit, then permits one lightsaber attack; DC 15 adds no bonus damage.
mechanics.form: Soresu: spend a Force Point to redirect the incoming attack to another target within 6 squares.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to take no damage when the check meets the attack roll.

rules.name: Disarming Slash
rules.description: Strike an opponent and tear its weapon away with the Force.

mechanics.target: One enemy within reach
mechanics.effect: Make one lightsaber attack; after dealing damage, use the activation result for an immediate disarm. Target's usual +10 Reflex bonus becomes +10/+5/+2/+0. On success, drop the weapon or call it to a free hand.
mechanics.form: Shii-Cho: use as a reaction when an adjacent opponent attacks you.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point after disarming to deal the same damage to the weapon.

rules.name: Drain Energy
rules.description: Empty the power supply of a weapon, device, or generator at range.

mechanics.target: One powered weapon or object within 6 squares and line of sight
mechanics.check: DC 20 Small; DC 25 Medium; DC 30 Large; DC 35 Huge
mechanics.effect: Completely drain its cells; it cannot function until the cells are replaced. At Huge size, a connected generator may be drained instead.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to affect one larger size category, up to Gargantuan.

rules.name: Draw Closer
rules.description: Pull a distant enemy into your blade's reach and immediately attack.

mechanics.target: One ungrabbed, ungrappled enemy within 6 squares and line of sight
mechanics.check: DC 15 Medium; DC 20 Large; DC 25 Huge; DC 30 Gargantuan
mechanics.effect: Pull target into nearest legal adjacent square, then make one lightsaber attack.
mechanics.form: Niman: range increases to 12 squares.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to choose any legal adjacent destination. This form power can be rebuked.

rules.name: Energy Resistance
rules.description: Wrap yourself in the Force to reduce energy, sonic, fire, cold, and electrical damage.

mechanics.target: You.
mechanics.check: Use the Force DC 20/25/30/35.
mechanics.effect: Gain DR 5/10/15/20, respectively, against the listed energy damage types.
mechanics.duration: Until the beginning of your next turn; maintain each round with a swift action.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to activate as a swift action. If damaged while maintaining, make Use the Force DC 15 + damage taken or maintenance ends.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 50

rules.name: Falling Avalanche
rules.description: Drive a foe backward with a crushing overhead strike and follow its retreat.

mechanics.target: One enemy no more than one size larger within reach
mechanics.effect: Make one lightsaber attack; on damage push target 1/2/3/4 squares and move through its vacated spaces to remain adjacent. Neither movement provokes; grabbed targets cannot move.
mechanics.form: Djem So: gain a temporary Force Point usable only for Djem So, lost after the encounter.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to knock the target prone after movement.

rules.name: Farseeing
rules.description: Reach through the Force for impressions about a distant or otherwise unseen creature, with the quality of information depending on your check.

source.name: Saga Edition Core Rulebook — Force Powers

rules.name: Fear
rules.description: Dark-side fear sharply restricts what an enemy can do on its next turn.

mechanics.target: One creature within 12 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.check: Use the Force must both meet the target's Will Defense and reach the desired tier: DC 15/20/25/30.
mechanics.effect: On its next turn the target may take, respectively, only one standard action / only one move action / only one swift action / no actions.
mechanics.duration: Through the target's next turn.
mechanics.special: Fear and mind-affecting effect. Spend a Force Point after a successful use to impose -2 to all of the target's Defenses until the beginning of your next turn. Dark-side use increases Dark Side Score by 1 and cannot have its activation check modified by a Force Point.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 50

rules.name: Fluid Riposte
rules.description: Turn an adjacent melee attack aside, reposition, and counterattack.

mechanics.action: Reaction to an adjacent melee attack
mechanics.target: You and the attacker
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. incoming attack roll
mechanics.effect: Success halves damage on a hit; then move to any other square adjacent to the attacker without provoking and make one lightsaber attack.
mechanics.form: Djem So: gain a temporary Force Point usable only for Djem So, lost after the encounter.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to treat the attacker as flat-footed against your counterattack.

rules.name: Fold Space
rules.description: Bend space to transport an object—or an occupied vehicle—nearly instantaneously.

mechanics.target: One held or unattended object within 6 squares and line of sight, or one vehicle you occupy
mechanics.check: DC 20 Medium/6 squares; DC 25 Large/12; DC 30 Huge/18; DC 35 Gargantuan/24; DC 40 Colossal/30
mechanics.effect: Transport the target and everything contained inside it to the destination.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point either to raise maximum size by two categories, up to Colossal (cruiser), or double distance.

rules.name: Force Disarm
rules.description: Use telekinesis to wrench a held object or weapon away from a target.

source.name: Saga Edition Core Rulebook — Force Powers

rules.name: Force Grip
rules.description: Telekinetically seize and crush a creature, dealing damage and potentially limiting its actions.

source.name: Saga Edition Core Rulebook — Force Powers

rules.name: Force Light
rules.description: Become a beacon that burns dark-side creatures and hinders their attacks.

mechanics.action: Standard action; standard action each round to maintain
mechanics.target: Creatures with Dark Side Score 1+ beginning their turns within 6 squares
mechanics.effect: Area effect dealing 1d6/2d6/3d6/4d6 Force damage and imposing -1 on attacks through the end of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point for +1d6 damage. Recheck to maintain; taking damage requires DC 15 + damage to continue.

rules.name: Force Lightning
rules.description: Blast a target with destructive dark-side energy, dealing damage and potentially worsening its condition.

source.name: Saga Edition Core Rulebook — Force Powers

rules.name: Force Scream
rules.description: A Force-amplified scream damages creatures that hear it and lowers their Damage Threshold.

mechanics.target: Every creature within 12 squares that can hear you.
mechanics.check: One Use the Force check compared with each target's Fortitude Defense; it must also reach DC 15/20/25/30.
mechanics.effect: A target whose Fortitude is met takes 1d6/2d6/3d6/4d6 Force damage and has Damage Threshold reduced by 5.
mechanics.duration: Damage Threshold reduction lasts until the end of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Fortitude size modifier: +5 Large, +10 Huge, +20 Gargantuan, +50 Colossal. Spend a Force Point to reduce Damage Threshold by 10 instead. Dark-side restrictions apply.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 50

rules.name: Force Slam
rules.description: Release a telekinetic wave that damages creatures in an area and can knock them prone.

source.name: Saga Edition Core Rulebook — Force Powers

rules.name: Force Storm (JATM)
rules.description: Create a howling acid storm that obscures and damages a chosen area.

mechanics.action: Standard action; standard action each round to maintain
mechanics.target: Area within 12 squares and line of sight
mechanics.check: DC 20 creates 3x3; DC 25 4x4; DC 30 5x5; DC 35 6x6
mechanics.effect: The area grants concealment, imposes -5 on Perception checks to listen, and deals 2d6 acid damage when a creature enters or begins its turn there; lasts through your next turn.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point for +2d6 acid damage. Maintaining requires a new check and concentration after damage.

rules.name: Force Stun
rules.description: Overwhelm a creature through the Force, moving it down the condition track according to your Use the Force result.

source.name: Saga Edition Core Rulebook — Force Powers

rules.name: Force Thrust
rules.description: Telekinetically shove a creature or object away from you, with stronger checks producing a more powerful push.

source.name: Saga Edition Core Rulebook — Force Powers

rules.name: Force Track
rules.description: Follow a particular creature's trail through guidance from the Force.

mechanics.target: You
mechanics.check: DC 15 trail up to 1 minute old; DC 20 10 minutes; DC 25 1 hour; DC 30 1 day
mechanics.effect: Track the creature without Survival checks for up to 1 hour while within line of sight of its trail.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to track two targets simultaneously.

rules.name: Force Whirlwind
rules.description: Suspend a target in a telekinetic vortex that immobilizes, hinders, damages, and finally drops it prone.

mechanics.time: Standard action; move action to maintain.
mechanics.target: One creature or droid within 12 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.check: Use the Force must meet Fortitude Defense and reach DC 15/20/25/30.
mechanics.effect: Immobilize the target; its attacks and skill checks take -5; deal 1d6/2d6/3d6/4d6 Force damage at the end of your turn. It falls prone when the effect ends.
mechanics.duration: Until the beginning of your next turn, extendable by a new check each round.
mechanics.special: Fortitude size modifier: +5 Large, +10 Huge, +20 Gargantuan, +50 Colossal. Force Point changes the action/skill penalty to -10. Damage while maintaining requires DC 15 + damage taken. If you or an ally attacks, damages, or moves the captive down the condition track, the whirlwind ends immediately.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 51

rules.name: Hatred
rules.description: Radiate hateful energy that injures nearby creatures and weakens every defense.

mechanics.action: Standard action; swift action each round to maintain
mechanics.target: Every creature beginning its turn within 6 squares
mechanics.effect: Deal 1d6/2d6/3d6/4d6 Force damage and impose -1 to all defenses through the end of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point for +1d6 damage. Maintaining requires a fresh check and concentration after damage.

rules.name: Hawk-Bat Swoop
rules.description: Leap into reach without provoking and strike before foes can react.

mechanics.target: You and one enemy
mechanics.effect: Move 2/4/6/8 squares without provoking; if you finish adjacent to a target, make one lightsaber attack.
mechanics.form: Ataru: move another 2 squares after the attack without provoking.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point for +2 weapon-damage dice.

rules.name: High Ground Defense
rules.description: Turn elevated or broken terrain into an opportunity-attack advantage.

mechanics.target: You
mechanics.effect: While on a low object or in difficult terrain, creatures moving adjacent provoke from you until your next turn; opportunity attacks gain +0/+1/+2/+5 Force bonus.
mechanics.form: Sokan: opportunity attacks deal +1 weapon-damage die.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to move 1 square without provoking after each opportunity attack during the duration.

rules.name: Inertia
rules.description: Alter your inertia to run along walls despite gravity.

mechanics.target: You
mechanics.check: DC 15 half speed; DC 20 speed; DC 25 speed +2; DC 30 speed +4
mechanics.effect: Move the listed distance along a wall as though it were ground; if unsupported at the end, you fall.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point for another +2 squares.

rules.name: Inspire
rules.description: Fill nearby allies with courage against fear and mental influence.

mechanics.action: Swift action; swift action each round to maintain
mechanics.target: All allies within 6 squares and line of sight
mechanics.check: DC 20 +2 Will; DC 25 +5; DC 30 +10; DC 35 immunity
mechanics.effect: Grant the listed Force bonus to Will against mind-affecting and fear effects through the end of your next turn, or immunity at DC 35.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to grant each target 2d6 bonus hit points for the encounter. Maintaining requires a new check and concentration after damage.

rules.name: Intercept
rules.description: Throw a small object into an incoming projectile's path to negate the attack.

mechanics.target: One incoming ranged attack targeting you
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. attack roll
mechanics.effect: On success, negate the attack against you.
mechanics.special: Also opposes Move Light Object or Move Object using the enemy's Use the Force result; a stopped Move Object cannot be maintained on that object. Spend a Force Point against autofire to take half damage on a hit or none on a miss.

rules.name: Ionize
rules.description: Overload an electronic target with ion damage through the Force.

mechanics.target: One target within 6 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.check: Use the Force must meet Reflex Defense and reach DC 20/25/30.
mechanics.effect: Deal 4d6/5d6/6d6 ion damage, respectively.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to add 2d6 ion damage. Resolve ion damage under the normal ion-damage rules.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 51

rules.name: Kinetic Combat
rules.description: Telekinetically wield a one-handed melee weapon at a distance using Charisma in place of physical strength.

mechanics.time: Standard action; swift action to maintain, plus a standard action to direct it each maintained round.
mechanics.target: You and one one-handed melee weapon you hold.
mechanics.check: Use the Force DC 20. Initial attack bonus is base attack bonus + Charisma modifier.
mechanics.effect: Move the weapon up to 12 squares and attack. Damage is normal weapon damage + half heroic level, substituting Charisma modifier for Strength. The weapon threatens adjacent squares and can make your attacks of opportunity.
mechanics.duration: Maintain round to round; the weapon must remain within 12 squares.
mechanics.special: While maintained, direct it up to 6 squares and make one adjacent attack. Feats and talents that normally enhance weapon use do not apply. Damage while maintaining requires DC 15 + damage taken. Spend a Force Point for +1 on attacks made this way.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 51

rules.name: Makashi Riposte
rules.description: Soften an adjacent melee blow and answer with a precise counterattack.

mechanics.action: Reaction to an adjacent melee attack
mechanics.target: You and the attacker
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. incoming attack roll
mechanics.effect: Success halves incoming damage on a hit; after resolution make one lightsaber attack, dealing half damage even if your counterattack misses.
mechanics.form: Makashi: through your next turn, the target provokes from you whenever it attacks within your reach.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to take no incoming damage when your check meets the attack.

rules.name: Memory Walk
rules.description: Force an intelligent enemy to relive its worst memories, injuring it and stripping actions.

mechanics.action: Standard action; standard action each round to maintain
mechanics.target: One Intelligence 3+ creature within 6 squares and line of sight
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. Will; minimum DC 20
mechanics.effect: Deal 2d6 Force damage. DC 20 removes next swift action; DC 25 next move; DC 30 next standard; DC 35 next standard and swift.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point for +2d6 damage. Maintaining requires a new check and concentration after damage.

rules.name: Mind Shard
rules.description: Splinter a foe's mind with pain, damaging it and locking down condition recovery.

mechanics.target: One creature within 12 squares and line of sight
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. Will; DC 15/20/25/30
mechanics.effect: Deal 2d8/3d8/4d8/5d8 Force damage, move the target -1 condition step, and prevent it from improving its own condition through the end of your next turn; allies may still help it.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point for +2d8 damage.

rules.name: Mind Trick
rules.description: Influence a creature's perceptions or behavior through the Force, subject to the power's normal limits on what can be suggested or perceived.

source.name: Saga Edition Core Rulebook — Force Powers

rules.name: Move Object
rules.description: Telekinetically move a visible target, or hurl it at another target; the maximum affected size depends on your Use the Force check.

source.name: Saga Edition Core Rulebook — Move Object

rules.name: Negate Energy
rules.description: Use the Force as a reaction to reduce or negate incoming energy damage and potentially regain hit points with an exceptional result.

source.name: Saga Edition Core Rulebook — Force Powers

rules.name: Pass the Blade
rules.description: Momentarily deactivate your blade so it passes through an attempted block.

mechanics.target: One enemy within reach
mechanics.effect: Make one lightsaber attack; target suffers -2/-5/-10 on Block or Primitive Block, or cannot Block at DC 30.
mechanics.form: Trakata: also ignore the target's Lightsaber Defense deflection bonus.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point for +2d6 damage on a hit.

rules.name: Plant Surge
rules.description: Command nearby plants to bind a creature in place.

mechanics.action: Standard action; swift action each round to maintain
mechanics.target: One creature within 12 squares and line of sight, adjacent to a plant
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. Fortitude Defense
mechanics.effect: Speed becomes 0 through the end of your next turn. The target may spend a standard action on a grapple check opposed by your activation result to escape.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to impose -10 on escape checks. Maintaining requires a new check each round and concentration after damage.

rules.name: Pushing Slash
rules.description: Strike a foe, then drive it backward with telekinetic force.

mechanics.target: One enemy within reach
mechanics.check: Attack, then Use the Force vs. Fortitude; DC 15/20/25/30
mechanics.effect: After a hit, push the ungrabbed target 2/3/4/5 squares without provoking.
mechanics.form: Niman: also compare the check to adjacent enemies; each beaten is pushed 1 square as an area effect.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to knock the primary target prone after movement. This form power can be rebuked.

rules.name: Rebuke
rules.description: React to another Force power and attempt to negate it with an opposed Use the Force check; a strong enough result can turn the power back on its user.

source.name: Saga Edition Core Rulebook — Force Powers

rules.name: Resist Force
rules.description: Reinforce one or more Defenses specifically against hostile Force powers.

mechanics.time: Standard action; swift action to maintain each active instance.
mechanics.target: You.
mechanics.check: Use the Force DC 15/20/25.
mechanics.effect: Choose one Defense and gain +1/+2/+5 against Force powers used against you.
mechanics.duration: Until the beginning of your next turn, extendable by maintenance.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to apply the bonus to two chosen Defenses. Multiple separately activated instances can coexist, but each costs its own swift action to maintain. Damage while maintaining requires DC 15 + damage taken.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 51

rules.name: Rising Whirlwind
rules.description: Attack two nearby enemies with paired blades and gain bonus vitality if both connect.

mechanics.target: Two different enemies within reach
mechanics.effect: Make one lightsaber attack against each; if both hit, gain 10/15/20/25 bonus hit points until the encounter ends.
mechanics.form: Jar'Kai: move up to 2 squares between attacks without provoking.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point for +1d6 damage against each target hit.

rules.name: Saber Swarm
rules.description: Overwhelm one opponent with two rapid lightsaber attacks.

mechanics.target: One enemy within reach
mechanics.effect: Make two lightsaber attacks, each at -5/-2/-1/0.
mechanics.form: Ataru: target suffers -5 on checks to Block these attacks or use Makashi Riposte.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to move 2 squares before or after without provoking.

rules.name: Sarlacc Sweep
rules.description: Sweep through a primary foe and carry damage into another nearby enemy.

mechanics.target: One primary and one secondary enemy within reach
mechanics.effect: Make one attack against primary; on a hit deal normal damage there and 5/5+1d6/5+2d6/5+3d6 to secondary.
mechanics.form: Shii-Cho: use in place of the attack at the end of a charge; Powerful Charge applies only to primary.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to affect two secondary targets within reach and adjacent to primary.

rules.name: Sever Force
rules.description: Disrupt a Force-user's connection to the Force, interfering with the target's ability to spend Force Points and use Force powers for a time.

source.name: Saga Edition Core Rulebook — Force Powers

rules.name: Shien Deflection
rules.description: Deflect a shot, rush its source, and counterattack.

mechanics.action: Reaction to a non-area ranged attack
mechanics.target: You and the attacker
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. attack; DC 15/20/25/30
mechanics.effect: Success halves damage on a hit; move toward attacker up to speed/speed+2/+4/+6, then attack if within reach.
mechanics.form: Shien: no cumulative penalties for multiple Deflect attempts through your next turn.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to take no damage when the check meets the attack.

rules.name: Slow
rules.description: Telekinetically burden a target, reducing speed and imposing the penalties of a heavy load.

mechanics.target: One creature or droid within 12 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.check: Use the Force must meet Fortitude Defense and reach DC 15/20/25/30.
mechanics.effect: Reduce speed by 1/2/3/4 squares and treat the target as carrying a heavy load: -10 on Acrobatics, Climb, Endurance, Initiative, Jump, Stealth, and Swim checks.
mechanics.duration: Until the beginning of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Fortitude size modifier: +5 Large, +10 Huge, +20 Gargantuan, +50 Colossal. Spend a Force Point to treat the target's Fortitude Defense as 5 lower for this activation.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 52

rules.name: Surge
rules.description: Use the Force to dramatically enhance movement, especially jumping and speed, for a brief burst.

source.name: Saga Edition Core Rulebook — Force Powers

rules.name: Swift Flank
rules.description: Dash around an adjacent opponent and strike from a flanking angle.

mechanics.target: You and one adjacent enemy
mechanics.effect: Move half speed/speed/speed+2/speed+4 without provoking, then make one adjacent lightsaber attack; if start and end spaces flank, target is flanked for it.
mechanics.form: Vaapad: target is flat-footed against you through the end of your turn.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point for +2 squares movement.

rules.name: Tempered Aggression
rules.description: Channel controlled aggression into a strike capable of becoming a critical hit.

mechanics.target: One enemy within reach
mechanics.effect: Make one lightsaber attack; it becomes a critical hit if it exceeds Reflex Defense by 10/5/2.
mechanics.form: Vaapad: the power loses the dark-side descriptor for you.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point for +2 weapon-damage dice after any critical doubling.

rules.name: Thought Bomb
rules.description: Radiate a telepathic shockwave that harms nearby enemies and steals their swift actions.

mechanics.target: All enemies within 2 squares
mechanics.check: One Use the Force check vs. each target's Will Defense
mechanics.effect: Each target beaten takes 2d6 Force damage and loses its swift action on its next turn; area effect.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point for +2d6 damage.

rules.name: Twin Strike
rules.description: Drive two lightsabers into one foe with a single combined attack.

mechanics.target: One enemy within reach
mechanics.effect: Make one lightsaber attack; on a hit add the other lightsaber's base damage dice. Gain +0/+1/+2 Force bonus to the attack.
mechanics.form: Jar'Kai: triple rather than double your Lightsaber Defense deflection bonus through your next turn.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point for +1 weapon-damage die.

rules.name: Unbalancing Block
rules.description: Half an adjacent melee attack and leave its attacker off balance.

mechanics.action: Reaction to an adjacent melee attack
mechanics.target: You
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. attack roll and attacker's Will Defense
mechanics.effect: Meeting the attack roll halves damage on a hit; meeting Will also leaves attacker flat-footed through the end of your next turn.
mechanics.form: Trakata: first attack against that attacker on your next turn deals +2 weapon-damage dice.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to take no damage when the check meets the attack.

rules.name: Unhindered Charge
rules.description: Rush through difficult terrain and low obstacles to strike a foe.

mechanics.target: You and one enemy
mechanics.effect: Move toward the enemy up to speed/speed+2/+4/+6 while ignoring difficult terrain and low obstacles, then attack if within reach.
mechanics.form: Sokan: gain +5 Force bonus to Reflex against opportunity attacks caused by this movement.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point for +2 squares movement.

rules.name: Valor
rules.description: Bolster an ally's Will Defense against fear and mental influence.

mechanics.time: Standard action; swift action to maintain each active instance.
mechanics.target: One creature or droid within 12 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.check: Use the Force DC 15/20/25/30.
mechanics.effect: Target gains +1/+2/+5/+10 Will Defense against mind-affecting and fear effects.
mechanics.duration: Until the start of your next turn, extendable by maintenance.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point on activation so the bonus applies against every effect targeting Will Defense. You may maintain separate instances on different allies, each costing a swift action. Damage while maintaining requires DC 15 + damage taken. Light-side Force Point restriction applies if you have a Dark Side Score.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 52

rules.name: Vital Transfer
rules.description: Transfer your own vitality through the Force to heal another living creature, at a cost to yourself.

source.name: Saga Edition Core Rulebook — Force Powers

rules.name: Vornskr's Ferocity
rules.description: Unleash a ferocious lightsaber attack for substantial extra damage.

mechanics.target: One enemy within reach
mechanics.effect: Make one lightsaber attack dealing +1/+2/+3/+4 weapon-damage dice on a hit.
mechanics.form: Juyo: the power loses the dark-side descriptor for you.
mechanics.special: Spend a Force Point to use this power as the attack at the end of a charge.

rules.name: Wound
rules.description: Inflict painful internal injury and make any resulting condition-track loss persistent.

mechanics.target: One creature or droid within 6 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. Fortitude Defense.
mechanics.effect: On success, deal 4d6 Force damage. If the target is moved down the condition track by the damage, that condition becomes persistent.
mechanics.duration: The persistent condition remains until removed by surgery with a DC 20 Treat Injury check.
mechanics.special: Fortitude size modifier: +5 Large, +10 Huge, +20 Gargantuan, +50 Colossal. Spend a Force Point for +2d6 damage. Dark-side restrictions apply.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 52

rules.name: Devastating Power
rules.description: Increase the number of damage dice rolled by a Force power.

special: Access to a Force secret from Force Disciple, Jedi Master, Sith Lord, or equivalent

mechanics.trigger: Use a Force power that deals damage.
mechanics.cost: Spend 1 Force Point to increase damage dice by 50%, or 1 Destiny Point to double the number of damage dice.
mechanics.effect: Increase only the power's damage dice; apply normal rounding and other modifiers afterward.
mechanics.special: Normal per-round Force Point and Destiny Point spending limits apply.

rules.name: Distant Power
rules.description: Extend a numerically expressed Force-power range enormously.

mechanics.trigger: Use a Force power with a numeric range.
mechanics.cost: Spend 1 Force Point to multiply range by 10, or 1 Destiny Point to extend range anywhere in the same star system.
mechanics.special: Does not remove line-of-sight requirements or make a nonnumeric range eligible.

rules.name: Holocron Loremaster
rules.description: Temporarily draw a nearby ally's known Force power into your suite and imprint your knowledge into holocrons.

mechanics.trigger: Whenever you activate a Force power.
mechanics.effect: Spend a Force Point to add one use of any Force power known by an ally within 12 squares to your suite. Once used, that granted use cannot be regained.
mechanics.duration: If unused, it disappears at the end of your next turn; spend a Destiny Point to retain it through encounter end.
mechanics.special: You may enhance a holocron you possess with your knowledge and create a gatekeeper in your image.

rules.name: Mentor
rules.description: Temporarily place a Force power you just activated into a nearby ally's suite.

special: Successfully trained an apprentice to knighthood or equivalent rank

mechanics.trigger: Whenever you activate a Force power.
mechanics.target: One ally within 12 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Spend a Force Point to add one use of that power to the ally's suite. Once used, the granted use cannot be regained.
mechanics.duration: If unused, it disappears at the end of the ally's next turn; either participant may spend a Destiny Point to retain it through encounter end.

rules.name: Multitarget Power
rules.description: Make a normally single-target Force power affect additional targets.

mechanics.trigger: Use a Force power that normally affects one target.
mechanics.cost: Spend 1 Force Point for one additional target, or 1 Destiny Point for one target per four character levels.
mechanics.effect: Resolve the power against every selected legal target.

rules.name: Quicken Power
rules.description: Activate a standard- or move-action Force power much faster.

mechanics.trigger: Activate a Force power that normally requires a standard or move action.
mechanics.cost: Spend 1 Force Point to activate it as a swift action, or 1 Destiny Point to activate it as a reaction.
mechanics.effect: Only the activation time changes; all other restrictions remain.

rules.name: Shaped Power
rules.description: Reshape a cone Force power into a long line or a selective area.

mechanics.trigger: Use a Force power with a cone area.
mechanics.cost: Spend 1 Force Point to create a 1-square-wide line whose length is five times the cone length, or 1 Destiny Point to affect chosen targets within the cone's normal range.
mechanics.effect: Replace the normal cone with the selected shape.
mechanics.special: Selected targets and line targets must still be legal for the power.

rules.name: Cure Disease
rules.description: Allow Vital Transfer to purge disease as well as restore health.

mechanics.trigger: Use Vital Transfer on a diseased target.
mechanics.check: Compare the Use the Force activation result with the disease's Treat Injury DC.
mechanics.effect: If the check meets the DC, spend a Force Point to cure that disease.

rules.name: Dominate Mind
rules.description: A particularly strong Mind Trick lets you dictate the target's next standard action.

mechanics.trigger: Your Mind Trick activation check exceeds the target's Will Defense by 10 or more.
mechanics.effect: Instead of the normal option, you may choose what the target does with its standard action on its next turn.
mechanics.special: The commanded action remains subject to Mind Trick's normal restrictions.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 53

rules.name: Extended Blind
rules.description: Increase the distance at which Blind can affect a target.

mechanics.effect: Blind's base range increases from 12 squares to 18 squares.

rules.name: Extended Force Disarm
rules.description: Increase Force Disarm's reach.

mechanics.effect: Force Disarm's base range increases from 12 squares to 18 squares.

rules.name: Extended Force Grip
rules.description: Increase Force Grip's reach.

mechanics.effect: Force Grip's base range increases from 12 squares to 18 squares.

rules.name: Extended Force Thrust
rules.description: Increase Force Thrust's reach.

mechanics.effect: Force Thrust's base range increases from 12 squares to 18 squares.

rules.name: Extended Move Object
rules.description: Increase Move Object's reach.

mechanics.effect: Move Object's base range increases from 12 squares to 18 squares.

rules.name: Force Point Recovery
rules.description: Recover one Force Point spent during an encounter after that encounter ends.

special: Access to a Force technique from a qualifying prestige class

mechanics.trigger: An encounter ends after you spent one or more Force Points during it.
mechanics.effect: Automatically recover 1 Force Point spent during that encounter.
mechanics.special: Cannot recover more than was spent and does not recover Destiny Points.

rules.name: Force Power Mastery
