rules.description: Master one Force power well enough to take 10 under pressure.

mechanics.trigger: Activate the selected Force power.
mechanics.effect: You may take 10 on its Use the Force check even while distracted or threatened.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for a different Force power each time.

rules.name: Improved Convection
rules.description: Make fire ignited by Convection scale with your combat training.

mechanics.effect: Fire caused by Convection attacks the target's Fortitude Defense using your base attack bonus instead of the fire effect's normal +5 attack bonus.

rules.name: Improved Crucitorn
rules.description: Retain Crucitorn when the attack still overwhelms your Damage Threshold.

mechanics.effect: If the attack or Force power still deals damage exceeding your Damage Threshold after Crucitorn, that use is not expended and remains in your suite.

rules.name: Improved Cryokinesis
rules.description: Extend Cryokinesis to occupied vehicles.

mechanics.effect: Cryokinesis may target an occupied vehicle in range; it moves down the condition track only if your activation result also exceeds its Fortitude Defense.

rules.name: Improved Energy Resistance
rules.description: Apply Energy Resistance to a nearby ally instead of yourself.

mechanics.trigger: Activate Energy Resistance.
mechanics.target: One ally within 6 squares instead of yourself.
mechanics.effect: The ally gains the power's normal protection using your activation result.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 53

rules.name: Improved Fold Space
rules.description: Transport Fold Space targets across line of sight or throughout a star system.

mechanics.effect: Spend a Force Point to move the target anywhere in line of sight, or spend a Destiny Point to move it anywhere in the same star system.

rules.name: Improved Force Light
rules.description: Blind creatures harmed by Force Light.

mechanics.effect: Spend a Force Point so creatures damaged by Force Light grant concealment to all other targets through the end of their next turns. Spend a Destiny Point instead to make it total concealment.

rules.name: Improved Force Slam
rules.description: Convert Force Slam into a circular burst centered on you.

mechanics.use: Full-round action instead of Force Slam's normal activation time.
mechanics.effect: Target every eligible creature in a 2-square-radius burst centered on you instead of the normal cone.
mechanics.special: Spend 1 Force Point to increase the burst radius to 4 squares.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 54

rules.name: Improved Force Storm (JATM)
rules.description: Fill the acid storm with targeted Force lightning.

mechanics.effect: Spend a Force Point when activating the storm. On activation and each standard action used to maintain it, compare your check with one creature's Reflex Defense inside; success deals 3d6 Force damage. Spend a Destiny Point to deal 6d6 instead.

rules.name: Improved Force Stun
rules.description: A successful Force Stun also immobilizes its victim briefly.

mechanics.trigger: Successfully affect a target with Force Stun.
mechanics.effect: The target is also immobilized for 1 round.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 54

rules.name: Improved Force Trance
rules.description: Recover hit points much faster while maintaining a Force trance.

mechanics.trigger: Remain in a Force trance for at least one hour.
mechanics.effect: Regain hit points equal to twice your character level for every hour spent in the trance.

rules.name: Improved Ionize
rules.description: Spend a Force Point so Ionize deals its full listed ion damage.

mechanics.trigger: Activate Ionize.
mechanics.effect: The target takes full ion damage instead of halving ion damage after comparison with its damage threshold.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 54

rules.name: Improved Kinetic Combat
rules.description: Control as many as three weapons simultaneously with Kinetic Combat.

mechanics.effect: Kinetic Combat may control up to three weapons at once.
mechanics.special: Moving and attacking with one of the controlled weapons still requires a standard action; the technique does not grant additional attacks by itself.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 54

rules.name: Improved Move Light Object
rules.description: Move a light object more quickly and launch it with less effort.

mechanics.effect: Use Move Light Object as a swift action instead of a move action. Using the object as a projectile requires a move action instead of a standard action.

rules.name: Improved Plant Surge
rules.description: Expand Plant Surge into an area restraint.

mechanics.effect: Spend a Force Point to target all enemies in a 5x5-square area with at least one square in range, or a Destiny Point for a 10x10-square area.

rules.name: Improved Resist Force
rules.description: Apply Resist Force to a nearby ally instead of yourself.

mechanics.trigger: Activate Resist Force.
mechanics.target: One ally within 6 squares instead of yourself.
mechanics.effect: The ally gains the power's normal defense using your activation result.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 54

rules.name: Improved Sense Force
rules.description: Search for Force-users and disturbances more quickly.

mechanics.effect: Use the Sense Force application of Use the Force as a move action instead of a full-round action.

rules.name: Improved Sense Surroundings
rules.description: Open your awareness to unseen surroundings without spending an action.

mechanics.effect: Use the Sense Surroundings application of Use the Force as a free action instead of a swift action.

rules.name: Improved Telepathy
rules.description: Make telepathic contact more reliably.

mechanics.trigger: Use the Telepathy application of Use the Force.
mechanics.effect: Roll twice and keep the better Use the Force result.

rules.name: Improved Thought Bomb
rules.description: Greatly enlarge Thought Bomb's affected area.

mechanics.effect: Spend a Force Point to target every enemy within 5 squares, or a Destiny Point to target every enemy in line of sight.

rules.name: Improved Valor
rules.description: Receive Valor's benefits yourself whenever you grant them to an ally.

mechanics.trigger: Activate Valor on an eligible target.
mechanics.effect: You also gain the same benefits from that activation.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 54

rules.name: Improved Vital Transfer
rules.description: Heal an ally with Vital Transfer from several squares away.

mechanics.target: One eligible target within 6 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Use Vital Transfer at range rather than requiring touch; all other costs and effects remain normal.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 54

rules.name: Language Absorption
rules.description: Use telepathy to temporarily absorb another creature's language.

mechanics.target: One creature that knows the desired language.
mechanics.check: If unwilling, Use the Force vs. Will Defense as for Telepathy.
mechanics.effect: You can speak and understand one language known by the target.
mechanics.duration: 24 hours.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 54

rules.name: Acrobatic Recovery
rules.description: Stay standing when an effect would knock you prone.

mechanics.trigger: An effect would make you fall prone.
mechanics.check: Acrobatics DC 20.
mechanics.effect: On success, remain standing.

rules.name: Action Exchange
rules.description: A successful Force Delay lets a nearby ally exchange movement for another major action.

special: Membership in the Jal Shey tradition

mechanics.trigger: You successfully use Force Delay.
mechanics.target: One ally within 6 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.effect: On the ally's next turn, that ally may trade its move action for an additional standard action.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 57

rules.name: Acute Senses
rules.description: Reroll Perception checks.

mechanics.trigger: You make a Perception check.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll it, but must accept the second result even if worse.
mechanics.special: For starships, applies to Use Computer checks made to detect or perceive enemy vessels.

rules.name: Adept Negotiator
rules.description: Use reason and Force-guided persuasion to move an enemy down the condition track.

mechanics.target: One Intelligence 3+ enemy able to see, hear, and understand you.
mechanics.check: Persuasion vs. Will; a higher-level target gains +5 Will.
mechanics.effect: Move target -1 condition step. At the bottom it remains conscious but cannot attack you or allies.
mechanics.duration: Bottom-track pacification lasts through encounter unless your side attacks it or one of its allies first.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; affects a vehicle occupant such as commander, not the vehicle.

rules.name: Advantageous Strike
rules.description: Exploit an opponent's movement with highly accurate melee opportunity attacks.

mechanics.trigger: Make an attack of opportunity with a melee weapon you are proficient with.
mechanics.effect: Gain +5 on the attack roll.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 47

rules.name: Adversary Lore
rules.description: Read a nearby enemy's weaknesses through the Force and expose them to your allies.

mechanics.target: One creature within 12 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: On success, the target takes -2 Reflex Defense against you and allies who can hear and understand you until the end of your next turn.

rules.name: Affliction
rules.description: A damaging single-target Force power inflicts delayed Force damage as well.

mechanics.trigger: You damage one opponent with a Force power.
mechanics.effect: At the beginning of that opponent's next turn, before it acts, it takes 2d6 Force damage.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 40

rules.name: Apprentice Boon
rules.description: Spend a Force Point to improve a less-experienced ally's Use the Force check.

mechanics.trigger: An ally within 12 squares whose Use the Force bonus is lower than yours makes a Use the Force check.
mechanics.effect: Add your Force Point roll to that ally's check, using your character level to determine the Force Point dice.

rules.name: Armor Mastery
rules.description: Increase the Dexterity bonus permitted by armor.

mechanics.effect: Increase the armor's maximum Dexterity bonus by 1.
mechanics.special: You must be proficient with the armor worn.

rules.name: Armored Defense
rules.description: Use the better of heroic level or armor bonus when calculating Reflex Defense.

mechanics.effect: When calculating Reflex Defense in armor, add either heroic level or armor bonus, whichever is higher.
mechanics.special: You must be proficient with the armor worn.

rules.name: Assault Tactics
rules.description: Coordinate concentrated attacks against one designated creature.

mechanics.target: One creature; allies must hear and understand you.
mechanics.check: Knowledge (Tactics) DC 15.
mechanics.effect: You and eligible allies deal +1d6 damage to the target with each successful melee or ranged attack.
mechanics.duration: Until start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting.

rules.name: Ataru
rules.description: Use agility rather than raw strength to drive lightsaber damage.

mechanics.effect: Add Dexterity bonus instead of Strength bonus to lightsaber damage. When wielding two-handed, apply twice Dexterity bonus instead of twice Strength bonus.

rules.name: Attract Minion
rules.description: Gain a loyal nonheroic follower whose level scales with yours.

mechanics.effect: Gain a loyal nonheroic minion with class levels equal to three-quarters of your character level, rounded down.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for additional minions, but normally only one accompanies you. An accompanying minion receives an equal party share of XP; calling a replacement requires normal travel time.

rules.name: Attune Weapon
rules.description: Bind a melee weapon to yourself through the Force for improved accuracy.

mechanics.target: One melee weapon.
mechanics.effect: You gain +1 Force bonus on attacks while wielding the attuned weapon.
mechanics.duration: Indefinite until another rule ends the attunement.
mechanics.special: The bonus applies only when you wield it; other wielders receive no benefit.

rules.name: Barter
rules.description: Reroll attempts to haggle.

mechanics.trigger: You make a Persuasion check to haggle.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll the check, but must accept the second result.

rules.name: Battle Analysis
rules.description: Assess which visible combatants or detected vehicles have lost at least half their hit points.

mechanics.check: Knowledge (Tactics) DC 15.
mechanics.effect: Learn which allies and opponents in your line of sight are at half maximum hit points or fewer.
mechanics.special: For vehicles, also succeed on Use Computer DC 15.

rules.name: Battle Meditation
rules.description: Spend a Force Point to coordinate nearby allies' attacks.

mechanics.target: You and allies within 6 squares when activated.
mechanics.effect: Gain +1 insight on attack rolls.
mechanics.duration: Rest of encounter while an ally remains within 6 squares and you remain conscious and alive.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; at starship scale affects allied gunners within 6 squares.

rules.name: Beast Trick
rules.description: Use Mind Trick on beasts and other creatures of animal intelligence.

mechanics.effect: Mind Trick can affect creatures with Intelligence 2 or lower.
mechanics.special: It cannot grant comprehension of complex commands or capabilities the beast lacks.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 53

rules.name: Block
rules.description: React with an ignited lightsaber to negate melee attacks.

special: Drawn and ignited lightsaber required to use the talent

mechanics.trigger: You are aware of a melee attack and are not flat-footed.
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. triggering attack roll; cumulative -5 for each Block or Deflect use since start of your last turn.
mechanics.effect: Negate a normal melee attack. Against a melee area attack, success means half damage if the area attack hits and no damage if it misses.
mechanics.special: Requires drawn, ignited lightsaber. Spend a Force Point to Block an attack against an adjacent character.

rules.name: Bolster Ally
rules.description: Help a wounded ally recover condition and gain temporary resilience.

mechanics.use: Standard action, once per ally each encounter.
mechanics.target: One ally in line of sight at half maximum hit points or fewer.
mechanics.effect: Move the ally +1 step toward normal on the condition track and grant bonus hit points equal to its character level.
mechanics.duration: Unused bonus hit points disappear at encounter end.
mechanics.special: Damage removes bonus HP first. Mind-affecting; cannot target yourself.

rules.name: Bonded Mount
rules.description: Create a lasting empathic bond with a friendly domesticated beast used as your mount.

mechanics.use: Full-round action; spend 1 Force Point when encountering a friendly or helpful domesticated beast.
mechanics.effect: Bond it as your mount and sense its emotions freely. While riding, it uses your Reflex and Will defenses and you gain any special senses it possesses that you lack.

rules.name: Born Leader
rules.description: Give visible allies an encounter-long attack bonus while they follow your lead.

mechanics.target: All allies in line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Grant +1 insight on attack rolls.
mechanics.duration: While each ally retains line of sight to you and you remain conscious and alive.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; cannot benefit yourself.

rules.name: Brutal Attack
rules.description: Deal an additional weapon die when a selected weapon breaks an opponent's damage threshold.

feats: Weapon Focus (selected weapon or weapon group)
special: Proficient with selected weapon or group

mechanics.trigger: An attack with the selected weapon deals damage equal to or greater than the target's damage threshold.
mechanics.effect: Add one weapon-damage die to that attack.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for different exotic weapons or weapon groups.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 44

rules.name: Call Out
rules.description: Make one opponent affected by Personal Vendetta substantially less accurate against anyone else.

mechanics.trigger: Use Personal Vendetta.
mechanics.target: One enemy affected by that use.
mechanics.effect: That enemy takes -5 on attacks against targets other than you instead of Personal Vendetta's normal -2.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 44

rules.name: Call Weapon
rules.description: Call a lightsaber you constructed into your hand and ignite it instantly.

mechanics.use: Free action using Move Light Object.
mechanics.target: One lightsaber you built and can see.
mechanics.effect: Move the lightsaber into your hand and ignite it.

rules.name: Cause Mutation
rules.description: Transform a willing or helpless creature into a Sith abomination or chrysalis beast.

mechanics.use: Work for a number of days equal to the resulting creature's modified Challenge Level, then spend 1 Force Point.
mechanics.target: One willing or unconscious creature.
mechanics.effect: Apply either the Sith Abomination or Chrysalis Beast template. The mutated creature counts as domesticated for you alone unless already domesticated.

rules.name: Channel Aggression
rules.description: Feed on an enemy's vulnerability to deliver a burst of dark-side damage.

mechanics.use: Free action after a successful attack.
mechanics.trigger: You hit a flanked target or one denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense.
mechanics.effect: Deal +1d6 damage per Force Adept class level, maximum +10d6.

rules.name: Channel Anger
rules.description: Enter a Force-fueled rage that improves melee offense but leaves you depleted.

mechanics.effect: Gain +2 rage on melee attack and melee damage rolls.
mechanics.duration: 5 rounds plus Constitution modifier; afterward move -1 condition step.
mechanics.special: While raging, cannot use patient or concentration-dependent skills such as Mechanics, Stealth, or Use the Force.

rules.name: Channel Energy
rules.description: Convert energy successfully absorbed with Negate Energy into an immediate Force power.

mechanics.trigger: Successfully negate damage from an energy-weapon attack using Negate Energy.
mechanics.effect: Immediately activate any Force power currently available in your suite.

rules.name: Channel Vitality
rules.description: Convert your physical condition into a temporary surge of Force energy.

mechanics.cost: Move -1 step down the condition track.
mechanics.effect: Gain 1 temporary Force Point usable before the end of your turn; otherwise it is lost.

rules.name: Charm Beast
rules.description: Use the Force instead of ordinary persuasion to calm and befriend unintelligent wild creatures.

mechanics.effect: Substitute Use the Force for Persuasion when changing the attitude of an undomesticated Intelligence 2-or-less creature. Ignore the normal -5 language-barrier penalty.
mechanics.special: Identical to the Dathomiri Witch talent of the same name for prerequisite purposes.

rules.name: Clear Mind
rules.description: Reroll attempts to hide your presence from other Force-users.

mechanics.trigger: Make an opposed Use the Force check to avoid detection by another Force-user.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll but must accept the second result.

rules.name: Closed Mind
rules.description: Force enemies to take the worse of two attempts when mentally influencing you.

mechanics.trigger: A mind-affecting effect targets your Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: The attacker rolls its attack or skill check twice and must use the lower result.

rules.name: Collective Visions
rules.description: Nearby Force-users can aid your Farseeing activation.

mechanics.trigger: You activate Farseeing or a Force power requiring Farseeing.
mechanics.target: Other Force-users within 6 squares who have Farseeing in their suites.
mechanics.effect: Each eligible helper may use aid another on your Use the Force check as a reaction.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 24

rules.name: Combat Trance
rules.description: Extend Battle Strike's attack bonus across an entire encounter while remaining aggressive.

mechanics.trigger: Activate Battle Strike.
mechanics.effect: Apply its attack bonus to your first melee attack each round through encounter end.
mechanics.duration: Ends immediately if you fail to make an attack during a round.

rules.name: Connections
rules.description: Use personal connections to acquire controlled equipment more easily and cheaply.

mechanics.effect: Obtain licensed, restricted, military, or illegal equipment without licensing fees or background checks when its total cost is at most character level × 1,000 credits; reduce black-market cost multiplier by 1.
mechanics.special: Availability and actual purchase cost still apply.

rules.name: Controlled Burst
rules.description: Control automatic weapon fire with substantially less loss of accuracy.

mechanics.effect: The attack penalty for autofire or Burst Fire is reduced to -2. When you brace an autofire-only weapon, you take no autofire attack penalty.

rules.name: Coordinate
rules.description: Make every visible ally's aid another attempt more effective.

mechanics.target: All allies in line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Their aid another actions grant an additional +1 bonus.
mechanics.duration: Until the start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Repeatable; each selection adds another +1, to a maximum additional +5. Mind-affecting; cannot benefit yourself.

rules.name: Crippling Strike
rules.description: Turn a critical hit into a lasting mobility injury.

mechanics.use: Free action on a critical hit.
mechanics.trigger: You score a critical hit.
mechanics.effect: Reduce the target's speed by half.
mechanics.duration: Until the target is restored to maximum hit points.

rules.name: Crucial Advice
rules.description: Your guardian spirit lets you retry one failed skill check with an advantage.

mechanics.use: Once per encounter after failing a skill check.
mechanics.effect: Reroll the check with +2 circumstance bonus and use the new result.
mechanics.special: For tiered checks, failure means not reaching the minimum DC.

rules.name: Damage Reduction 10
rules.description: Spend a Force Point for temporary Damage Reduction.

mechanics.effect: Gain DR 10.
mechanics.duration: 1 minute.

rules.name: Dark Deception
rules.description: Mask your true alignment behind apparent anger and hatred.

mechanics.trigger: Another character attempts to sense you through the Force.
mechanics.effect: You may choose to appear as though your Dark Side Score equals your Wisdom score.
mechanics.special: Deception becomes a class skill for you.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Dark Healing
rules.description: Drain a nearby creature's life to heal yourself.

mechanics.target: One creature within 6 squares.
mechanics.check: Ranged attack vs. Fortitude Defense.
mechanics.effect: On a hit, deal 1d6 damage per Sith Apprentice class level and heal the same amount; on a miss, no effect.

rules.name: Dark Healing Field
rules.description: Drain life from as many as three nearby creatures and heal from their combined suffering.

mechanics.target: Up to three creatures within 12 squares.
mechanics.check: One Use the Force check compared with each target's Fortitude Defense.
mechanics.effect: Each target whose Fortitude is met takes 1d6 damage per Sith class level; a missed target takes half. You heal half the total damage dealt across all targets.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 40

rules.name: Dark Presence
rules.description: Grant nearby allies a Force bonus to all Defenses.

mechanics.target: You and allies within 6 squares.
mechanics.effect: Gain +1 Force bonus to all Defenses.
mechanics.duration: Until encounter end while within range and while you remain conscious and alive.

rules.name: Dark Retaliation
rules.description: Answer a dark-side Force power with an immediate Force power of your own.

mechanics.trigger: You are targeted by a Force power with the dark-side descriptor.
mechanics.effect: Immediately activate one Force power as the reaction.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 25

rules.name: Dark Scourge
rules.description: Gain a dark-side attack bonus against Jedi characters.

mechanics.target: Characters with Jedi class levels.
mechanics.effect: Gain +1 dark-side bonus on attack rolls against them.

rules.name: Dark Side Adept
rules.description: Retry activation checks for Force powers tied strongly to the dark side.

mechanics.trigger: Activate a Force power with the dark-side descriptor.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll the Use the Force check, but must keep the second result.

rules.name: Dark Side Manipulation
rules.description: Maximize a Force Point die when spending it as part of an act that earns a Dark Side Point.

mechanics.trigger: Spend a Force Point on an act that would give you a Dark Side Point.
mechanics.effect: Treat the Force Point die as though it rolled its maximum value.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 59

rules.name: Dark Side Master
rules.description: Spend a Force Point to keep the better result when Dark Side Adept rerolls a power.

mechanics.trigger: Use Dark Side Adept to reroll a dark-side power's activation check.
mechanics.effect: Keep the better of the two Use the Force results.

rules.name: Dark Side Savant
rules.description: Recover a spent dark-side Force power once each encounter.

mechanics.use: Swift action, once per encounter per selection.
mechanics.effect: Return one spent Force power with the dark-side descriptor to your suite without spending a Force Point.
mechanics.special: Each additional selection grants another use per encounter.

rules.name: Dark Side Scourge
rules.description: Deal additional melee damage to known dark-side creatures.

mechanics.target: A creature you know has Dark Side Score 1+.
mechanics.effect: Add your Charisma bonus, minimum +1, to melee damage against it.
mechanics.special: You must be aware of the target's dark-side status.

rules.name: Dark Side Sense
rules.description: Reroll checks to sense dark-side characters.

mechanics.trigger: Make Use the Force to sense the presence and relative location of characters with Dark Side Score 1+.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll but must accept the second result.

rules.name: Dark Side Talisman
rules.description: Imbue a portable object with dark-side energy that protects one defense from light-side powers.

mechanics.effect: Choose Fortitude, Reflex, or Will when creating the talisman. While carrying it, gain +2 Force bonus to that defense against Force powers with the light-side descriptor.
mechanics.special: Only one dark-side talisman may be active, though a normal Force talisman may coexist. If destroyed, another cannot be created for 24 hours.

rules.name: Dastardly Strike
rules.description: Successful attacks against defensively compromised enemies worsen their condition.

mechanics.trigger: You hit an opponent denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense.
mechanics.effect: Move that target -1 step down the condition track in addition to normal attack effects.
mechanics.special: Cannot affect objects or vehicles.

rules.name: Debilitating Shot
rules.description: An aimed ranged hit pushes the victim down the condition track.

mechanics.trigger: You aim and then hit with a ranged attack.
mechanics.effect: Move the target -1 condition step in addition to dealing damage.

rules.name: Deception Awareness
rules.description: Use the Force to resist and detect deception or outside influence.

special: Membership in the Order of Shasa

mechanics.effect: Gain +5 Will Defense against Deception. Use Use the Force instead of Perception to sense deception or influence and count as trained in Perception for those uses; qualifying Perception rerolls apply to the substituted check.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 61

rules.name: Deceptive Shot
rules.description: Feint at range to compromise a nearby target's defenses.

mechanics.use: Two swift actions in the same turn.
mechanics.target: One target in line of sight within 6 squares.
mechanics.check: Deception vs. Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: On success, the target is denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense against your attacks.
mechanics.duration: Until start of your next turn.

rules.name: Defensive Circle
rules.description: Turn Battle Meditation into a coordinated defense and strengthen lightsaber reactions near allied Jedi.

mechanics.use: Swift action while Battle Meditation is active.
mechanics.target: You and allies currently affected by your Battle Meditation.
mechanics.effect: Affected characters gain +2 insight to Reflex Defense for as long as the meditation affects them. You also gain +1 on Use the Force checks for Block and Deflect per adjacent ally wielding a lightsaber.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Deflect
rules.description: React with an ignited lightsaber to negate ranged attacks.

mechanics.trigger: You are aware of a ranged attack and not flat-footed.
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. triggering attack roll; cumulative -5 for every Block or Deflect use since start of your last turn.
mechanics.effect: Negate a normal ranged attack. Against autofire or Force lightning, success means half damage if hit and none if missed.
mechanics.special: Requires drawn, ignited lightsaber. Force Point allows protection of an adjacent character. No effect on other area attacks, or Colossal-frigate+ vehicle attacks unless point-defense.

rules.name: Demand Surrender
rules.description: Compel a badly wounded opponent to surrender.

mechanics.use: Standard action, once per encounter and once per target each encounter.
mechanics.target: One opponent at half hit points or fewer.
mechanics.check: Persuasion vs. Will; target gains +5 Will if higher level than you.
mechanics.effect: Target surrenders, drops held weapons, and takes no hostile actions.
mechanics.duration: Until you or an ally attacks it.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting. A hailed vehicle at half HP may surrender through its commander; it cannot be more than one size larger, and higher-CL vehicles gain +5 Will.

rules.name: Demolitionist
rules.description: Placed explosives deal additional damage dice.

mechanics.trigger: Use Mechanics to place an explosive device.
mechanics.effect: Its explosion deals +2 damage dice per selection.
mechanics.special: Repeatable; the additional dice stack.

rules.name: Deployment Tactics
rules.description: Direct allies to exploit flanking or avoid opportunity attacks.

mechanics.check: Knowledge (Tactics) DC 15.
mechanics.effect: You and allies able to see, hear, and understand you gain either +1 competence on attacks against flanked opponents or +1 dodge to Reflex against opportunity attacks.
mechanics.duration: Until start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting. Bonus becomes +2 if you possess Born Leader or Battle Analysis.

rules.name: Devastating Attack
rules.description: Reduce a target's effective Damage Threshold against a selected weapon family.

special: Proficient with selected weapon or group

mechanics.trigger: You hit using the selected exotic weapon or weapon group.
mechanics.effect: Treat the target's Damage Threshold as 5 lower when resolving that attack.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for different selections. Heavy Weapons selection applies to vehicle weapon attacks.

rules.name: Devastating Melee Smash
rules.description: Make one especially damaging melee attack each encounter.

mechanics.use: Declare before one melee attack, once per encounter.
mechanics.effect: On a hit, add half your character level to damage instead of Melee Smash's normal +1.
mechanics.special: Does not stack with Powerful Charge bonus damage.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 29

rules.name: Dirty Tricks
rules.description: Feint rapidly against an opponent you threaten.

mechanics.target: One opponent you threaten.
mechanics.effect: Use the feint application of Deception against that opponent.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 47

rules.name: Disarming Attack
rules.description: Disarm more effectively with a selected weapon and bypass armor during the attempt.

talents: Weapon Specialization (selected weapon or weapon group)
special: Proficient with selected weapon or group

mechanics.effect: Ignore the target's armor bonus to Reflex Defense when disarming with the selected weapon.
mechanics.special: Once per encounter as a free action, gain +10 on one disarm attack using it. Repeatable for different selections.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 29

rules.name: Disciplined Strike
rules.description: Exclude allies or other targets from your area Force powers.

mechanics.trigger: Activate a Force power with an area effect.
mechanics.effect: Exclude a number of targets from the power equal to Wisdom modifier, minimum 1.

rules.name: Disruptive
rules.description: Suppress morale and insight bonuses affecting visible enemies.

mechanics.target: Every enemy in your line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Suppress all morale and insight bonuses currently applied to those enemies.
mechanics.duration: Until the start of your next turn.

rules.name: Distant Command
rules.description: Born Leader continues to help allies after line of sight is broken.

mechanics.effect: Allies benefiting from Born Leader no longer lose its bonus merely because line of sight to you is broken.
mechanics.special: The bonus still ends if another Born Leader termination condition applies.

rules.name: Distracting Apparition
rules.description: A manifested guardian distracts and unsettles nearby enemies.

mechanics.effect: Enemies within 3 squares of the manifested spirit take -2 Will Defense and -2 on attacks against you.

rules.name: Distracting Attack
rules.description: A damaging hit can distract the target and reduce its Reflex Defense.

mechanics.trigger: Deal damage with a melee or ranged attack using the weapon selected for Brutal Attack.
mechanics.check: Compare the existing attack roll against the target's Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: If the attack roll also equals or exceeds Will, target takes -2 to Reflex Defense.
mechanics.duration: Until end of your next turn.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 44

rules.name: Djem So
rules.description: Answer a successful melee attack with an immediate counterstrike.

mechanics.trigger: An opponent hits you with a melee attack.
mechanics.effect: Immediately make one attack against that opponent.

rules.name: Dogfight Gunner
rules.description: Fire vehicle weapons accurately while another pilot handles the dogfight.

mechanics.trigger: Your vehicle is in a dogfight and you are not its pilot.
mechanics.effect: You take no dogfight penalty on attacks with vehicle weapons.

rules.name: Drain Force
rules.description: Sap a Force-sensitive enemy's power when you damage them.

mechanics.trigger: You damage a Force-sensitive opponent.
mechanics.effect: Regain one spent Force power and cause the target to lose 1 Force Point.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 40

rules.name: Draw Fire
rules.description: Force affected enemies to target you instead of nearby allies.

mechanics.check: Persuasion vs. each visible opponent's Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: An affected opponent cannot attack another character within 6 squares of you, though it may attack you.
mechanics.duration: Until the start of your next turn while you do not have cover from that opponent.
mechanics.special: As vehicle pilot, can protect allied vehicles no more than one size larger than yours.

rules.name: Dual Weapon Flourish I
rules.description: Follow one standard-action attack with a free strike from your second light weapon.

mechanics.use: Free action after the qualifying standard-action attack.
mechanics.trigger: While wielding only two light melee weapons or two lightsabers, make one standard-action attack with one weapon.
mechanics.target: The same target.
mechanics.effect: Make one attack with the other weapon, applying the normal two-weapon penalties.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 47

rules.name: Dual Weapon Flourish II
rules.description: Complete a two-weapon full attack as a standard action.

mechanics.trigger: Wield only two light melee weapons or two lightsabers.
mechanics.effect: Make a full attack, provided you attack with both weapons; apply the normal two-weapon penalties to the attacks.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 47

rules.name: Echoes in the Force
rules.description: Use Farseeing on your present location to witness meaningful events from its past.

mechanics.use: Use Farseeing while physically standing at the location.
mechanics.check: Use the Force DC 20 +1 per day into the past.
mechanics.effect: View significant events that occurred there at the designated number of days in the past rather than targeting a creature.

rules.name: Educated
rules.description: Attempt every Knowledge specialty even without training.

mechanics.effect: You may make any Knowledge check untrained.

rules.name: Elusive Dogfighter
rules.description: Outmaneuver an opposing pilot so their dogfight attack is far less accurate.

mechanics.trigger: You win the opposed Pilot check used to attack in a dogfight.
mechanics.target: The opposing pilot.
mechanics.effect: That pilot takes -10 on the resulting attack roll.

rules.name: Elusive Target
rules.description: Ranged attackers suffer an additional penalty while you are engaged in melee.

mechanics.trigger: You are fighting one or more opponents in melee.
mechanics.effect: Other opponents take -5 on ranged attacks against you.
mechanics.special: Stacks with the normal -5 penalty for firing into melee, for -10 total when both apply.

rules.name: Embrace the Dark Side
rules.description: Use dark-side powers more reliably at the permanent cost of light-side powers.

mechanics.trigger: Activate a Force power with the dark-side descriptor.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll the Use the Force check, but must keep the second result.
mechanics.special: After selecting this talent, you can no longer use Force powers with the light-side descriptor.

rules.name: Empower Weapon
rules.description: Imbue a melee weapon so it deals an additional die of damage in your hands.

mechanics.target: One melee weapon.
mechanics.effect: The weapon deals one additional weapon-damage die when wielded by you; for example, 2d8 becomes 3d8.
mechanics.special: Other wielders receive no bonus damage.

rules.name: Entreat Beast
rules.description: Direct a small beast to deliver, retrieve, or manipulate a nearby object.

mechanics.target: One indifferent-or-better beast.
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: On success, the beast performs one minor task: deliver an object from you to a target within 30 squares, retrieve a visible unattended object within 30 squares and bring it to you, or activate an unattended button, lever, or similar control within 30 squares.

rules.name: Equilibrium
rules.description: Spend a Force Point to clear debilitating conditions and return to normal.

mechanics.effect: Remove all debilitating conditions affecting you and return to your normal state.
mechanics.special: GM adjudicates conditions whose own rules expressly prevent removal.

rules.name: Esoteric Technique
rules.description: Force techniques and secrets fortified by a Force Point also reinforce your vitality.

mechanics.trigger: Spend a Force Point to activate a Force technique or Force secret.
mechanics.effect: Gain bonus hit points equal to 10 + your Force Adept class level.
mechanics.duration: Until encounter end; damage removes bonus hit points first.

rules.name: Evasion
rules.description: Greatly reduce damage from area attacks.

mechanics.trigger: An area attack targets you.
mechanics.effect: Take half damage if the attack hits and no damage if it misses.
mechanics.special: If you are a vehicle's pilot, the benefit applies to that vehicle.

rules.name: Exotic Weapon Mastery
rules.description: Use every exotic weapon as though proficient with it.

mechanics.effect: You are treated as proficient with all exotic weapons even without the corresponding Exotic Weapon Proficiency feats.

rules.name: Exotic Weapons Master
rules.description: Treat all exotic weapons as one group so existing exotic-weapon feats apply to every one of them.

special: Proficient with at least one exotic weapon

mechanics.effect: All exotic weapons become one weapon group for you. A feat that grants proficiency with or improves one exotic weapon instead grants that benefit to all exotic weapons.
mechanics.special: For example, one Exotic Weapon Proficiency or Weapon Focus selection becomes proficiency or focus for the exotic-weapons group.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 44

rules.name: Expert Grappler
rules.description: Improve grapple attacks.

mechanics.effect: Gain +2 competence on grapple attacks.

rules.name: Expert Gunner
rules.description: Improve accuracy with mounted vehicle weapons.

mechanics.effect: Gain +1 on attack rolls made with vehicle weapons.

rules.name: Expert Tracker
rules.description: Follow tracks at normal speed without the usual penalty.

mechanics.effect: Remove the normal -5 Survival penalty for following tracks while moving at your normal speed.

rules.name: Extreme Effort
rules.description: Spend time preparing for a powerful physical effort.

mechanics.effect: Gain +5 on one Strength check or Strength-based skill check made during the same round.

rules.name: Fearless Leader
rules.description: Give visible allies strong protection against fear.

mechanics.target: Your allies.
mechanics.effect: Grant +5 morale to Will Defense against fear effects.
mechanics.duration: Remainder of encounter while the ally retains line of sight and you remain conscious and alive.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; cannot benefit yourself.

rules.name: Field Detection
rules.description: Sense nearby energy fields and identify shield fluctuations that your attacks can exploit.

special: Membership in the Luka Sene tradition

mechanics.check: Use the Force DC 15.
mechanics.effect: Detect the presence, general strength, type, and origin or direction of electromagnetic and energy fields within 12 squares, including communications, sensors, and electronics. Against a personal or vehicle shield you damage, a successful check reduces its SR by 5 against your attacks.
mechanics.duration: Shield reduction lasts until end of your turn.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 60

rules.name: Field Tactics
rules.description: Help nearby allies extract maximum protection from existing cover.

mechanics.target: You and allies within 10 squares who hear and understand you.
mechanics.check: Knowledge (Tactics) DC 15.
mechanics.effect: Characters who already have cover gain +10 cover to Reflex Defense instead of +5.
mechanics.duration: Until start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; grants no cover where none exists.

rules.name: Fluster
rules.description: Intimidate an enemy so severely that it can take only a swift action.

mechanics.target: One visible creature.
mechanics.check: Persuasion to intimidate against Will; a higher-level target gains +5 Will.
mechanics.effect: Instead of normal intimidation, target may take only one swift action on its next turn.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 24

rules.name: Fool's Luck
rules.description: Spend a Force Point to gain one strong encounter-long competence bonus.

mechanics.effect: Choose +1 competence on attack rolls, +5 competence on skill checks, or +1 competence to all Defenses.
mechanics.duration: Remainder of encounter.
mechanics.special: The Defense option also increases the Defenses of a vehicle you occupy.

rules.name: Force Deception
rules.description: Use the Force to cloak lies and substitute Use the Force for Deception.

mechanics.effect: Use your Use the Force modifier instead of Deception and count as trained in Deception. Deception rerolls apply to the substituted check under the same restrictions.

rules.name: Force Delay
rules.description: Use a Force-assisted verbal shock to deprive an intelligent opponent of an action.

special: Membership in the Jal Shey tradition

mechanics.target: One Intelligence 3+ creature that understands you.
mechanics.check: Persuasion vs. Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: On success, target loses its move action on its next turn. If you spend 1 Force Point, it loses its standard action instead.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 57

rules.name: Force Flow
rules.description: A disastrous attack or Force check grants a temporary Force Point.

mechanics.trigger: Roll a natural 1 on an attack roll or Use the Force check.
mechanics.effect: Gain 1 temporary Force Point.
mechanics.duration: Unused point disappears at encounter end.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 52

rules.name: Force Focus
rules.description: Regain a spent Force power through concentration.

mechanics.check: Use the Force DC 15.
mechanics.effect: On success, return one spent Force power of your choice to your active suite.

rules.name: Force Fortification
rules.description: Spend a Force Point to turn a critical hit against you into an ordinary hit.

mechanics.cost: Spend 1 Force Point, even if you already spent one this round.
mechanics.trigger: An attack scores a critical hit against you.
mechanics.effect: Negate the critical; resolve the attack's normal damage instead.

rules.name: Force Harmony
rules.description: Use one Force-Point-powered talent freely each encounter.

mechanics.effect: Activate one Force talent that normally requires spending a Force Point without spending that point.

rules.name: Force Haze
rules.description: Hide yourself and allies behind a Force illusion.

mechanics.target: Up to your Jedi class level in creatures within line of sight.
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. Will of each opponent who gains line of sight to a hidden creature.
mechanics.effect: On success, all hidden creatures have total concealment against that opponent.
mechanics.duration: Up to 1 minute; ends immediately if anyone hidden by it attacks.
mechanics.special: May hide one occupied vehicle if its size penalty is no greater than your heroic level.

rules.name: Force Intuition
rules.description: Use Use the Force in place of Initiative.

mechanics.effect: Use your Use the Force modifier instead of Initiative when making or rerolling Initiative checks.
mechanics.special: As pilot, may determine a starship's Initiative this way.

rules.name: Force Perception
rules.description: Use Use the Force for major Perception applications and count as trained in Perception.

mechanics.effect: Use Use the Force instead of Perception to avoid surprise, notice enemies, sense deception, or sense influence; count as trained in Perception.
mechanics.special: A permitted Perception reroll may reroll the substituted Use the Force check under the same limits.

rules.name: Force Persuasion
rules.description: Substitute Use the Force for Persuasion.

mechanics.effect: Use your Use the Force modifier instead of Persuasion when making or rerolling Persuasion checks.

rules.name: Force Pilot
rules.description: Use Use the Force instead of Pilot.

mechanics.effect: Use your Use the Force modifier instead of Pilot when making or rerolling Pilot checks.

rules.name: Force Power Adept
rules.description: Specialize in one Force power and spend a Force Point to improve its activation check.

special: Force Adept or Force Disciple talent access

mechanics.trigger: Activate the selected Force power.
mechanics.effect: Roll the Use the Force check twice and keep the better result.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for a different known Force power; effects do not stack.

rules.name: Force Recovery
rules.description: Second wind heals additional hit points based on remaining Force Points.

mechanics.trigger: You use second wind.
mechanics.effect: Regain an additional 1d6 hit points per Force Point you currently possess, maximum 10d6.
mechanics.special: Does not spend those Force Points.

rules.name: Force Revive
rules.description: Use Battle Meditation to let a fallen ally trigger a second wind immediately.

mechanics.trigger: An ally affected by your Battle Meditation is reduced to 0 hit points.
mechanics.effect: The ally immediately uses second wind as a reaction.
mechanics.special: The ally falls unconscious before second wind resolves, but can recover from the restored hit points normally.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Force Suppression
rules.description: A failed Rebuke can still reduce a variable Force power's effect.

mechanics.trigger: Your Rebuke fails to equal or exceed an opposing activation check.
mechanics.effect: Reduce that Force power's result by one listed effect tier.
mechanics.special: Only affects powers with multiple effects based on activation result; does nothing to static-resolution powers such as Force Lightning.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 53

rules.name: Force Talisman
rules.description: Imbue a worn or carried object with protection for one defense.

mechanics.target: One worn or portable object.
mechanics.effect: While wearing or carrying it, gain +1 Force bonus to Reflex, Fortitude, or Will, chosen when created.
mechanics.special: Only one active talisman at a time. If destroyed, you cannot create another for 24 hours.

rules.name: Force Treatment
rules.description: Use the Force in place of medical training and work without normal medical supplies.

special: Force Adept or Force Disciple talent access

mechanics.effect: Use Use the Force instead of Treat Injury and count as trained in Treat Injury. Treat Injury rerolls apply to the substituted check under the same restrictions.
mechanics.special: You may administer first aid and treat disease, poison, or radiation without a medpac or medical kit.

rules.name: Force Warning
rules.description: Warn nearby allies of danger, improving initiative and preventing some allies from being surprised.

mechanics.trigger: Combat begins.
mechanics.target: Allies within 12 squares.
mechanics.effect: Each target may reroll Initiative but must keep the second result. If you are not surprised, choose surprised allies up to your Wisdom modifier, minimum 1; those allies are no longer surprised and may act in the surprise round.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 40

rules.name: Foresight
rules.description: Spend a Force Point to reroll Initiative and keep the better result.

mechanics.trigger: You make an Initiative check.
mechanics.effect: Reroll and keep the better result.
mechanics.special: If the reroll is a natural 20, immediately regain the Force Point spent.

rules.name: Fortified Body
rules.description: The Force renders your body immune to several environmental and biological threats.

special: Force Adept or Force Disciple talent access

mechanics.effect: You are immune to disease, poison, and radiation.

rules.name: Fortune's Favor
rules.description: A critical hit grants an extra standard action.

mechanics.trigger: You score a critical hit with a melee or ranged attack.
mechanics.effect: Gain one free standard action.
mechanics.duration: Must be used before the end of the current turn or it is lost.

rules.name: Fringe Savant
rules.description: A natural 20 on a skill check grants a temporary Force Point.

mechanics.trigger: During an encounter, roll a natural 20 on a skill check.
mechanics.effect: Gain 1 temporary Force Point.
mechanics.duration: Unused point disappears at encounter end.

rules.name: Full Throttle
rules.description: Push a vehicle to extreme speed with exceptional consistency.

mechanics.effect: You may take 10 on Pilot checks made to increase vehicle speed. When piloting with all-out movement, the vehicle moves up to five times its speed instead of four times.

rules.name: Gambler
rules.description: Improve Wisdom checks made when gambling.

mechanics.effect: Gain +2 competence on Wisdom checks to gamble.
mechanics.special: Repeatable; each selection adds another +2.

rules.name: Gauge Force Potential
rules.description: Determine another creature's basic Force capabilities.

mechanics.target: One creature in line of sight.
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: Learn whether it has Force Sensitivity, how many Force powers it knows, and its current Force Point total; not which powers.

rules.name: Gimmick
rules.description: Issue routine computer commands almost instantly.

mechanics.effect: Issue a routine command to a computer; this normally requires a standard action.

rules.name: Greater Dark Side Talisman
rules.description: Your dark-side talisman protects all three defenses from light-side powers.

mechanics.effect: Dark Side Talisman's +2 Force bonus applies simultaneously to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will against light-side Force powers.

rules.name: Greater Devastating Attack
rules.description: Treat a target's damage threshold as dramatically lower with one chosen weapon group.

feats: Weapon Focus (selected weapon or weapon group)
special: Proficient with selected weapon or group

mechanics.trigger: Hit using the selected exotic weapon or weapon group.
mechanics.effect: Treat the target's damage threshold as 10 lower when resolving the attack; this replaces Devastating Attack's normal reduction.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for different weapon selections.

rules.name: Greater Force Talisman
rules.description: Extend your Force talisman's protection to all three defenses.

mechanics.effect: Your Force Talisman grants its +1 Force bonus to Reflex, Fortitude, and Will instead of only one defense.

rules.name: Greater Penetrating Attack
rules.description: Bypass more damage reduction with one selected weapon group.

feats: Weapon Focus (selected weapon or weapon group)
special: Proficient with selected weapon or group

mechanics.trigger: Hit using the selected exotic weapon or weapon group.
mechanics.effect: Treat the target's Damage Reduction as 10 lower when resolving damage; this replaces Penetrating Attack's normal reduction.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for different weapon selections.

rules.name: Greater Weapon Focus
rules.description: Gain another accuracy bonus with one selected weapon group.

feats: Weapon Focus (selected weapon or weapon group)
special: Proficient with selected weapon or group

mechanics.effect: Gain +1 on attacks with the selected exotic weapon or weapon group; this stacks with Weapon Focus.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for different weapon selections.

rules.name: Greater Weapon Focus (Fira)
rules.description: Gain another accuracy bonus with the traditional fira.

special: Membership in the Order of Shasa

mechanics.effect: Gain +1 on melee attacks with a fira, stacking with Weapon Focus.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 61

rules.name: Greater Weapon Focus (Lightsabers)
rules.description: Gain an additional accuracy bonus with lightsabers.

mechanics.effect: Gain +1 on melee attacks with lightsabers, stacking with Weapon Focus.

rules.name: Greater Weapon Specialization
rules.description: Deal still more damage with one specialized weapon group.

feats: Weapon Focus (selected weapon or weapon group)
talents: Weapon Specialization (selected weapon or weapon group)
special: Proficient with selected weapon or group

mechanics.effect: Gain +2 damage with the selected exotic weapon or weapon group, stacking with Weapon Specialization.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for different weapon selections.

rules.name: Greater Weapon Specialization (Lightsabers)
rules.description: Gain additional lightsaber damage beyond ordinary specialization.

mechanics.effect: Gain +2 on melee damage with lightsabers, stacking with Weapon Specialization.

rules.name: Grenade Defense
rules.description: Hurl an incoming grenade harmlessly aside with the Force.

mechanics.use: Reaction when attacked by a grenade.
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. the grenade's attack roll.
mechanics.effect: On success, redirect it to a harmless location and negate the attack.
mechanics.special: Whether successful or not, take -5 on Use the Force checks until the start of your next turn.

rules.name: Guardian Spirit
rules.description: Receive guidance and a daily reserve of Force energy from a watching spirit.

mechanics.effect: When using Search Your Feelings, consult the spirit to learn the nature of immediate consequences and whether an action advances your destiny. After 6 hours' rest, gain one bonus Force Point usable only to improve a Force power or activate a Force technique or secret.
mechanics.duration: Unused bonus point disappears at the start of the next day.

rules.name: Gun Club
rules.description: Use a ranged weapon as a club without the improvised-weapon penalty.

mechanics.effect: Make melee attacks with a ranged weapon without the normal -5 improvised-weapon penalty; treat it as a club.
mechanics.special: A rifle with a bayonet may be wielded as a double weapon: bayonet normally, other end as a club.

rules.name: Harm's Way
rules.description: Redirect attacks from an adjacent ally onto yourself.

mechanics.target: One adjacent ally.
mechanics.effect: Attacks against the ally target you instead, including damage and other effects.
mechanics.duration: Until the start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: You may decline protection against an individual attack before its roll. A pilot can similarly protect an allied vehicle no more than one size larger.

rules.name: Hidden Movement
rules.description: Move at normal speed without penalizing Stealth.

mechanics.effect: Take no Stealth penalty for moving at your normal speed.
mechanics.special: Also applies to Stealth checks while piloting a starship.

rules.name: Hold the Line
rules.description: A successful opportunity attack stops an enemy from leaving your reach.

mechanics.trigger: Hit a target with an attack of opportunity as it leaves your threatened area.
mechanics.effect: Immediately stop the target's movement and end the movement action.

rules.name: Hunter's Mark
rules.description: An aimed ranged hit also degrades the quarry's condition.

mechanics.trigger: You aim and then hit with a ranged attack.
mechanics.effect: Move the target -1 condition step in addition to dealing damage.

rules.name: Hunter's Target
rules.description: Designate one opponent as your quarry and deal increased damage to it.

mechanics.target: One opponent.
mechanics.effect: Each successful melee or ranged attack against it gains bonus damage equal to your Bounty Hunter class level.
mechanics.duration: Rest of encounter.

rules.name: Hyperdriven
rules.description: Once daily aboard a starship, add your Scoundrel level after seeing a roll.

mechanics.use: Once per day while aboard a starship.
mechanics.trigger: After seeing the result of one attack roll, skill check, or ability check.
mechanics.effect: Add your Scoundrel class level as a bonus to that roll or check.

rules.name: Ignite Fervor
rules.description: A successful attack inspires an ally's next damaging blow.

mechanics.use: Free action after you hit with a melee or ranged attack.
mechanics.target: One ally in your line of sight.
mechanics.effect: The ally gains bonus damage equal to its character level on its next attack.
mechanics.duration: Consumed by the next attack; lost if that attack misses.
mechanics.special: The ally need not remain in sight after selection. Mind-affecting; cannot target yourself.

rules.name: Illusion
rules.description: Create a convincing sensory illusion through the Force.

mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. each viewer's Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: A viewer whose Will is exceeded believes the chosen illusion is real.
mechanics.duration: Minutes equal to heroic level.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting. Physical interaction reveals it. Size penalty to check: -1 Huge, -2 Gargantuan, -5 Colossal, -10 Colossal-frigate or larger.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 52

rules.name: Illusion Bond
rules.description: See and hear from the position of a humanoid illusion you create.

mechanics.trigger: Create a humanoid illusion with Illusion.
mechanics.effect: You can see and hear as though standing in the illusion's space for its duration.

rules.name: Imbue Item
rules.description: Attune a crafted item so it can store one Force Point for your later use.

special: Membership in the Jal Shey tradition

mechanics.use: Full-round action to imbue the item; full-round action to store a Force Point; swift action to spend the stored point.
mechanics.cost: Spend 1 Force Point to imbue a specially crafted weapon, item, armor, or garment.
mechanics.effect: The attuned item can store one Force Point transferred into it by its wearer; you may later spend that stored point, even in a round when you spend one of your own.
mechanics.special: Attune only one item per 24 hours; it functions only for you; only one attuned item may be worn; one point maximum stored; maximum two Force Points spent in a round, one personal and one stored.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 58

rules.name: Impel Ally I
rules.description: Spend your own swift action to make an ally move immediately.

mechanics.use: Swift action; usable up to three times during your turn.
mechanics.target: One ally.
mechanics.effect: The ally immediately moves up to its speed during your turn, before you continue; otherwise the granted movement is lost.

rules.name: Impel Ally II
rules.description: Spend two swift actions to grant an ally an immediate action.

mechanics.target: One ally.
mechanics.effect: The ally immediately takes one standard or move action during your turn, before you continue; otherwise the opportunity is lost.

rules.name: Improved Armored Defense
rules.description: Combine heroic level with part of your armor bonus for Reflex Defense.

mechanics.effect: For Reflex Defense, use the better of: armor bonus; or heroic level + half armor bonus, rounded down.
mechanics.special: You must be proficient with the armor worn.

rules.name: Improved Battle Meditation
rules.description: Activate Battle Meditation swiftly, at greater range, while hindering enemies.

mechanics.use: Battle Meditation becomes a swift action.
mechanics.effect: Its radius increases to 12 squares; enemies within the radius take -1 on attack rolls while allies receive the normal benefit.
mechanics.duration: Uses Battle Meditation's normal encounter duration and proximity requirements.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 25

rules.name: Improved Dark Healing
rules.description: Drain life from twice the distance and still inflict partial harm on a miss.

mechanics.effect: Dark Healing's range becomes 12 squares. On a missed attack, the target still takes half damage and you heal the same amount.

rules.name: Improved Force Sight
rules.description: Refine Miralukan Force sight for rapid searching and automatic awareness of surroundings.

special: Membership in the Luka Sene tradition

mechanics.effect: Use the Search application of Perception as a swift action. You automatically succeed on the Sense Surroundings application of Use the Force without rolling.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 60

rules.name: Improved Initiative
rules.description: Reroll Initiative checks.

mechanics.trigger: You make an Initiative check.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll it, but must accept the second result even if worse.

rules.name: Improved Quick Draw
rules.description: Draw and fire a pistol in a surprise round even when caught unaware.

mechanics.trigger: A surprise round begins while you carry a pistol in hand or holster.
mechanics.effect: You may draw it and make one attack during the surprise round even if surprised. If surprised, this is the single action you take.

rules.name: Improved Quick Draw (Lightsabers)
rules.description: Draw, ignite, and attack with a lightsaber during a surprise round, even when surprised.

mechanics.trigger: A surprise round begins while a lightsaber is in your hand or on your belt.
mechanics.effect: Draw, ignite, and make one attack even if surprised. If not surprised, you may instead take any normal single action.
mechanics.special: Once per turn on your turn, you may draw and ignite a lightsaber as a free action.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 40

rules.name: Improved Sentinel Strike
rules.description: Increase the bonus-damage die from Sentinel Strike.

mechanics.effect: Each bonus-damage die granted by Sentinel Strike becomes d8 instead of d6.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Improved Sentinel's Gambit
rules.description: Use Sentinel's Gambit several additional times each encounter.

mechanics.effect: Gain additional uses of Sentinel's Gambit per encounter equal to half your Jedi Knight class level, minimum 1.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Improved Stealth
rules.description: Reroll Stealth checks.

mechanics.trigger: You make a Stealth check.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll it, but must accept the second result even if worse.
mechanics.special: Also applies to Stealth checks made while piloting a starship.

rules.name: Improved Weaken Resolve
rules.description: Your Weaken Resolve victim continues fleeing even after being wounded.

mechanics.effect: Weaken Resolve no longer ends when the fleeing target is wounded.
mechanics.special: All other Weaken Resolve limits, saves, and vehicle rules remain unchanged.

rules.name: Improvised Weapon Master
rules.description: Use improvised weapons without the usual attack penalty.

mechanics.effect: Take no penalty on attack rolls made with improvised weapons.

rules.name: Indomitable
rules.description: Rapidly recover several steps on the condition track.

mechanics.use: Swift action, once per day per selection.
mechanics.effect: Move +5 steps toward normal on the condition track.
mechanics.special: Does not remove or bypass a persistent condition and does not affect a vehicle's condition track. Repeatable for another daily use.

rules.name: Influence Savant
rules.description: Recover a spent mind-affecting Force power once each encounter.

mechanics.use: Swift action, once per encounter per selection.
mechanics.effect: Return one spent Force power with the mind-affecting descriptor to your suite without spending a Force Point.
mechanics.special: Each additional selection grants one additional use per encounter.

rules.name: Inspire Confidence
rules.description: Grant allies lasting morale bonuses to attacks and skills.

mechanics.target: All allies in your line of sight.
mechanics.effect: All affected allies gain +1 morale on attack rolls and skill checks.
mechanics.duration: Rest of encounter, or until you are unconscious or dead; allies need not remain in sight.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; does not affect you.

rules.name: Inspire Fear I
rules.description: Your reputation weakens opponents who are no more experienced than you.

mechanics.target: Opponents whose character level is no greater than yours.
mechanics.effect: Targets take -1 on attack rolls and opposed skill checks against you, and -1 on Use the Force checks to activate powers targeting you.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting fear effect.

rules.name: Inspire Fear II
rules.description: Deepen the penalties imposed by your fearsome reputation.

mechanics.effect: The penalty imposed by Inspire Fear becomes -2 instead of -1.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting fear effect.

rules.name: Inspire Fear III
rules.description: Your infamy imposes an overwhelming penalty on eligible opponents.

mechanics.effect: The penalty imposed by Inspire Fear becomes -5 instead of -2.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting fear effect.

rules.name: Inspire Haste
rules.description: Enable an ally to perform a standard-action skill task as a move action.

mechanics.target: One ally in line of sight.
mechanics.effect: On the ally's next turn, one skill check that normally costs a standard action costs a move action.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; cannot target yourself.

rules.name: Inspire Zeal
rules.description: Allies push enemies an additional step down the condition track.

mechanics.trigger: An ally in your line of sight attacks and moves an opponent down the condition track.
mechanics.effect: The attack moves the opponent one additional step down the condition track.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting benefit; cannot benefit yourself.

rules.name: Instinctive Navigation
rules.description: Use the Force to astrogate and operate sensors while piloting.

mechanics.effect: While you are a vehicle's pilot, substitute Use the Force for Use Computer checks made to astrogate or operate sensors.

rules.name: Intimidating Defense
rules.description: Intimidate an attacker into hesitating mid-strike.

mechanics.trigger: A visible creature makes a melee or ranged attack against you.
mechanics.check: Persuasion to intimidate against Will; a higher-level target gains +5 Will.
mechanics.effect: On success, impose -5 on the triggering attack roll.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 24

rules.name: Jar'Kai
rules.description: Double the defensive value of Lightsaber Defense while wielding two lightsabers.

mechanics.trigger: Use Lightsaber Defense while wielding two lightsabers.
mechanics.effect: Gain twice its normal deflection bonus to Reflex Defense.

rules.name: Jedi Battle Commander
rules.description: Improve the offensive coordination granted by Battle Meditation.

mechanics.effect: Your Battle Meditation grants +2 insight on attack rolls instead of +1.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Jedi Quarry
rules.description: Designate a quarry and move faster whenever closing to engage it.

mechanics.target: One creature.
mechanics.effect: Whenever a move action ends adjacent to the quarry, increase your speed for that movement by 2 squares.
mechanics.duration: Until the quarry surrenders, reaches 0 hp or the bottom condition step, or the encounter ends; cannot designate another while active.

rules.name: Juggernaut
rules.description: Armor no longer slows ordinary movement or running.

mechanics.effect: Ignore armor-based reductions to speed and run distance.
mechanics.special: You must be proficient with the armor worn.

rules.name: Juke
rules.description: Fight defensively from the cockpit while retaining offensive pressure.

mechanics.trigger: You fight defensively while serving as vehicle pilot.
mechanics.effect: The vehicle gains +5 dodge to Reflex Defense even if you make an attack.

rules.name: Jury-Rigger
rules.description: Reroll Mechanics checks made for jury-rigged repairs.

mechanics.trigger: You make a Mechanics check to jury-rig a repair.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll the check, but must accept the second result.

rules.name: Juyo
rules.description: Focus aggressively on a single foe and improve your first attack each round.

mechanics.target: One enemy in line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Reroll your first attack roll against that enemy each round and keep the better result.
mechanics.duration: Rest of encounter.

rules.name: Keen Shot
rules.description: Attack through ordinary concealment without an accuracy penalty.

mechanics.effect: Ignore the attack-roll penalty caused by concealment.
mechanics.special: Does not negate total concealment or allow targeting something you cannot locate.

rules.name: Keep It Together
rules.description: Prevent a threshold-breaking hit from worsening your vehicle's condition.

mechanics.trigger: A vehicle you pilot takes damage equal to or greater than its damage threshold.
mechanics.effect: The vehicle does not move down the condition track from exceeding its threshold; damage is otherwise resolved normally.

rules.name: Knack
rules.description: Reroll a skill check and retain the better result.

mechanics.trigger: You make any skill check.
mechanics.effect: Reroll the check and keep the better of the two results.
mechanics.special: Repeatable; each selection adds one daily use.

rules.name: Knockdown Shot
rules.description: An aimed ranged hit knocks an appropriately sized target prone.

mechanics.trigger: You aim and then hit with a ranged attack.
mechanics.effect: Knock the target prone in addition to dealing damage.
mechanics.special: Cannot knock down a target two or more size categories larger than you.

rules.name: Know Weakness
rules.description: Enemies exposed by Adversary Lore suffer extra damage from every successful allied attack.

mechanics.trigger: Successfully use Adversary Lore.
mechanics.effect: Until the end of your next turn, the target takes +1d6 damage from every successful attack by you or an ally who can hear and understand you.

rules.name: Knowledge of the Force
rules.description: Spend a Force Point to assist a nearby ally's Use the Force check as a reaction.

special: Membership in the Jal Shey tradition

mechanics.target: One ally within 6 squares.
mechanics.effect: Use aid another on the ally's Use the Force check, following the normal aid-another rules.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 58

rules.name: Krath Illusions
rules.description: Reduce the size penalty when creating large Force illusions.

mechanics.trigger: Create an illusion subject to a size penalty.
mechanics.effect: Reduce the size penalty by half, rounded down, to a minimum penalty of -1.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 60

rules.name: Krath Intuition
rules.description: Maximize the damage of a Sith alchemical weapon once per encounter.

mechanics.trigger: Roll damage with a Sith alchemical weapon.
mechanics.effect: Treat every damage die as though it rolled its maximum value.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 60

rules.name: Krath Surge
rules.description: Use rudimentary Sith sorcery to increase one Force power's damage or range.

mechanics.trigger: Activate a Force power.
mechanics.effect: Either add one die of damage if the power deals damage, or extend its range by 6 squares if it has a range beyond self or a single-target-only range.
mechanics.special: The affected power automatically gains the dark-side descriptor.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 60

rules.name: Lightsaber Defense
rules.description: Use an ignited lightsaber to increase Reflex Defense.

mechanics.effect: Gain +1 deflection to Reflex Defense per selection.
mechanics.duration: Until start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Requires drawn, ignited lightsaber and awareness; no benefit while flat-footed. Repeatable to maximum +3.

rules.name: Lightsaber Form Savant
rules.description: Recover a spent lightsaber-form Force power during an encounter.

mechanics.use: Swift action, once per encounter per selection.
mechanics.effect: Return one spent Force power with the lightsaber-form descriptor to your suite without spending a Force Point.
mechanics.special: Each additional selection grants one additional use per encounter.

rules.name: Lightsaber Specialist
rules.description: A lightsaber you personally built improves your Block and Deflect checks.

mechanics.effect: While armed with a lightsaber you built, gain +2 morale bonus on Use the Force checks made for Block and Deflect.

rules.name: Lightsaber Throw
rules.description: Throw a lightsaber proficiently and pull it back with the Force.

mechanics.use: Standard action to throw; swift action to retrieve.
mechanics.check: If target was within 6 squares, Use the Force DC 20 returns it to your hand.
mechanics.effect: Treat the lightsaber as a proficient thrown weapon using normal range penalties and normal weapon damage.
mechanics.special: Without this talent, a thrown lightsaber is an improvised weapon.

rules.name: Link
rules.description: Form a Force bond allowing two trained allies to assist each other's Force checks reactively.

mechanics.use: Standard action to link; free action for either participant to end.
mechanics.target: One willing ally trained in Use the Force within 12 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.effect: While within 12 squares, either participant may aid the other's Use the Force check as a reaction.
mechanics.cost: The assisting character takes -5 on all Use the Force checks until the end of their next turn.
mechanics.duration: Until encounter end, voluntarily ended, or range is broken; one active link at a time.

rules.name: Lockdown Strike
rules.description: Stop a moving opponent when your attack of opportunity connects.

mechanics.trigger: Hit a moving opponent no more than one size category larger than you with an attack of opportunity.
mechanics.effect: Immediately end that opponent's current movement.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 44

rules.name: Long Stride
rules.description: Increase ground and natural movement speeds while lightly armored.

mechanics.effect: Increase ground speed by 2 squares; also increase any natural fly, climb, or swim speed by 2.
mechanics.special: Functions only in light armor or no armor.

rules.name: Lucky Shot
rules.description: Reroll an attack and keep the better result.

mechanics.trigger: You make an attack roll.
mechanics.effect: Reroll and keep the better result.
mechanics.special: Repeatable; each selection adds one daily use.

rules.name: Lucky Stop
rules.description: Luck negates the damage from an attack that would drop you.

mechanics.trigger: An attack would reduce you to 0 hit points.
mechanics.effect: Negate all damage from that single attack.
mechanics.special: Negates damage, not necessarily unrelated non-damage effects unless those effects require damage to occur.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 27

rules.name: Luka Sene Master
rules.description: Gain one encounter-limited Force Point dedicated to Luka Sene and perception-related Force abilities.

special: Membership in the Luka Sene tradition

mechanics.effect: Gain 1 temporary Force Point usable only to activate a Sense- or Luka Sene-tree talent, activate Farseeing, or modify a Use the Force check for Search Your Feelings or Sense Force.
mechanics.duration: Unused point disappears at encounter end.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 60

rules.name: Makashi
rules.description: Improve Lightsaber Defense while dueling with one blade in one hand.

mechanics.trigger: Use Lightsaber Defense while wielding one lightsaber in one hand.
mechanics.effect: Increase its deflection bonus by 2, still subject to a maximum total bonus of +5.

rules.name: Manifest Guardian Spirit
rules.description: Manifest your guardian on the battlefield to reinforce your attacks, Force use, and resolve.
