mechanics.use: Swift action; spend 1 Force Point. Move spirit up to 6 squares as a swift action once per turn.
mechanics.target: Place spirit within 6 squares.
mechanics.effect: While it remains within 12 squares, gain +1 morale on attacks, +2 morale on Use the Force, and +2 morale to Will Defense. It occupies a space but does not obstruct movement.
mechanics.duration: Encounter.

rules.name: Masquerade
rules.description: Turn an Illusion into a deceptive disguise covering your own appearance.

mechanics.effect: Use Illusion to disguise yourself; its Use the Force result becomes the deceptive-appearance result under the Deception skill, while all Illusion limits still apply.

rules.name: Master Negotiator
rules.description: A successful Adept Negotiator use moves the target two condition steps.

mechanics.trigger: You successfully use Adept Negotiator.
mechanics.effect: Move the target -2 condition steps total instead of -1.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; still affects a vehicle character rather than the vehicle.

rules.name: Master Slicer
rules.description: Reroll attempts to improve computer access.

mechanics.trigger: Make a Use Computer check to improve access.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll the check and keep the better result.

rules.name: Master of Elegance
rules.description: Use Dexterity instead of Strength for damage with light melee weapons.

special: Dual Weapon Flourish I or Single Weapon Flourish I

mechanics.effect: Add Dexterity bonus instead of Strength bonus to damage with a light melee weapon. When wielded two-handed, apply twice Dexterity bonus instead of twice Strength bonus.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 47

rules.name: Master of the Great Hunt
rules.description: Specialized training makes you exceptionally deadly against dark-side beasts.

mechanics.target: A beast with Dark Side Score 1+.
mechanics.effect: Gain +1 Force bonus on attacks and +1 weapon-damage die with lightsaber attacks against it.

rules.name: Masterwork Lightsaber
rules.description: Construct exceptionally refined lightsabers with added accessories and more reliable damage.

mechanics.effect: A lightsaber you build may have one additional accessory. When you hit with one you built, reroll one damage die but keep the second result.
mechanics.special: When mentoring another character's lightsaber construction, reduce that character's Use the Force construction DC by 5.

rules.name: Melee Smash
rules.description: Deal additional damage with every melee attack.

mechanics.effect: Gain +1 damage on melee attacks.

rules.name: Mind Probe
rules.description: Touch a creature and search its mind for rumors, secrets, or another person's location.

mechanics.target: One living Intelligence 3+ creature.
mechanics.check: Against an unwilling target, Use the Force must first meet Will Defense; the same result must also meet the relevant Gather Information DC.
mechanics.effect: Retrieve information using Learn News and Rumors, Learn Secret Information, or Locate Individual without bribes and within this action.
mechanics.special: Failing by 5+ does not reveal that you sought the information.

rules.name: Mobile Attack (Lightsabers)
rules.description: Reposition freely after completing a two-lightsaber full attack.

mechanics.use: Free action immediately after the qualifying full attack.
mechanics.trigger: Complete a full attack using two lightsabers or both ends of a double-bladed lightsaber.
mechanics.effect: Move up to your speed.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Motion of the Future
rules.description: Spend Farseeing to glimpse an incoming attack and force the aggressor to try again.

mechanics.use: Swift action; remove one Farseeing use from your active suite.
mechanics.effect: Before the end of your next turn, when targeted by an attack or Force power, force the attacker to reroll its attack or Use the Force check and keep the second result.
mechanics.special: Counts as using Farseeing against that attacker but replaces Farseeing's normal effect.

rules.name: Multiattack Proficiency (Advanced Melee Weapons)
rules.description: Reduce full-attack penalties when making multiple attacks with advanced melee weapons.

mechanics.trigger: Make multiple attacks with advanced melee weapons as a full attack.
mechanics.effect: Reduce the multiple-attack penalty by 2 per selection.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 47

rules.name: Multiattack Proficiency (Exotic Weapons)
rules.description: Reduce full-attack penalties when making multiple attacks with exotic weapons.

mechanics.trigger: Make multiple attacks with exotic weapons as a full attack.
mechanics.effect: Reduce the multiple-attack penalty by 2 per selection.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 45

rules.name: Multiattack Proficiency (Heavy Weapons)
rules.description: Reduce full-attack penalties when making multiple heavy-weapon attacks.

mechanics.trigger: Make multiple attacks with heavy weapons as a full attack.
mechanics.effect: Reduce the multiple-attack penalty by 2 per selection.

rules.name: Multiattack Proficiency (Lightsabers)
rules.description: Reduce full-attack penalties when making multiple lightsaber attacks.

mechanics.trigger: Make multiple attacks with lightsabers as a full attack.
mechanics.effect: Reduce the multiple-attack penalty by 2 per selection.

rules.name: Multiattack Proficiency (Pistols)
rules.description: Reduce full-attack penalties when making multiple pistol attacks.

mechanics.trigger: Make multiple pistol attacks as a full attack.
mechanics.effect: Reduce the multiple-attack penalty by 2 per selection.

rules.name: Multiattack Proficiency (Rifles)
rules.description: Reduce full-attack penalties when making multiple rifle attacks.

mechanics.trigger: Make multiple attacks with rifles as a full attack.
mechanics.effect: Reduce the multiple-attack penalty by 2 per selection.

rules.name: Mystic Mastery
rules.description: Your breadth of Force talents increases the Force Points gained whenever you level.

mechanics.trigger: Gain a character level.
mechanics.effect: Gain additional Force Points equal to the number of Force talents you possess, maximum +6.

rules.name: Niman
rules.description: Adopt a balanced lightsaber stance that reinforces body and mind.

mechanics.trigger: You wield a lightsaber.
mechanics.effect: Gain +1 to Reflex Defense and Will Defense.

rules.name: Notorious (Bounty Hunter)
rules.description: Your reputation makes undisguised intimidation more reliable.

mechanics.trigger: Make Persuasion to intimidate while not disguised.
mechanics.effect: Roll twice and keep the better result.

rules.name: Notorious (Crime Lord)
rules.description: Your criminal reputation lets you retry undisguised intimidation.

mechanics.trigger: Make a Persuasion check to intimidate while not disguised.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll the check, but must keep the second result.

rules.name: Nowhere to Hide
rules.description: Retry attempts to gather information about a specific person's whereabouts.

mechanics.trigger: Make Gather Information to locate a specific individual.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll, but must keep the second result.

rules.name: One for the Team
rules.description: Shift some or all attack damage between yourself and an adjacent ally.

mechanics.trigger: A single attack damages you or an adjacent ally.
mechanics.effect: You may take half or all damage dealt to the ally; likewise, the adjacent ally may take half or all damage dealt to you even without this talent.
mechanics.special: Transfers damage from that attack, not unrelated effects.

rules.name: Out of Nowhere
rules.description: Capitalize on a successful feint with an immediate light-weapon attack.

mechanics.use: Free action on your turn, once per encounter.
mechanics.trigger: You successfully feint against an opponent.
mechanics.effect: Make one attack with a light melee weapon or lightsaber.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 47

rules.name: Outmaneuver
rules.description: Strip visible enemies of tactical attack and defense bonuses.

mechanics.target: Enemies in your line of sight.
mechanics.check: Knowledge (Tactics) DC 15; the highest-level visible enemy officer may oppose as a reaction and defeats this use with a higher result.
mechanics.effect: Targets lose competence, insight, and morale bonuses on attacks and all dodge bonuses to Reflex Defense.
mechanics.duration: Until start of your next turn.

rules.name: Penetrating Attack
rules.description: Reduce Damage Reduction against attacks with a selected weapon family.

feats: Weapon Focus (selected weapon or weapon group)
special: Proficient with selected weapon or group

mechanics.trigger: You hit using the selected exotic weapon or weapon group.
mechanics.effect: Treat the target's Damage Reduction as 5 lower for that attack.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for different selections. Heavy Weapons selection applies to vehicle weapon attacks.

rules.name: Perfect Attunement
rules.description: A Force Point spent improving an attack with your own lightsaber also improves its damage.

mechanics.trigger: Spend a Force Point to add to an attack roll made with a lightsaber you built.
mechanics.effect: If the attack hits, add the same Force Point result to the damage roll.

rules.name: Perfect Telepathy
rules.description: Transmit complete sentences and complex thoughts through telepathy.

mechanics.effect: When using the Telepathy application of Use the Force, you may communicate full sentences and complete thoughts rather than basic phrases.
mechanics.special: The recipient can still answer only with basic emotions or a single thought unless it has equivalent capability.

rules.name: Personal Vendetta
rules.description: Taunt nearby enemies into focusing their attacks on you.

mechanics.target: All enemies within 12 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.effect: On each target's next turn, it takes -2 on attacks made against anyone other than you.
mechanics.duration: Through each affected enemy's next turn.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 45

rules.name: Power of the Dark Side
rules.description: Increase a Force Point's attack bonus die at the cost of corruption.

mechanics.trigger: Spend a Force Point to modify an attack roll.
mechanics.effect: Roll one additional Force die and apply the best single die result.

rules.name: Prepared for Danger
rules.description: Convert an unused Farseeing power into any other spent Force power.

mechanics.cost: Expend one unspent Farseeing use from your suite.
mechanics.effect: Return any one other spent Force power to your suite.

rules.name: Presence
rules.description: Intimidate far more quickly.

mechanics.effect: Make the Persuasion check to intimidate a creature; it normally requires a full-round action.

rules.name: Progenitor's Call
rules.description: Invoke ancestral voices to confuse an enemy and impose a persistent condition.

special: Membership in the Order of Shasa

mechanics.target: One enemy.
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: On success, target moves -1 persistent condition step and loses its standard action on its next turn.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting. A creature can be affected only once per encounter. Persistent condition ends after Treat Injury DC 15 or 8 hours of rest.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 61

rules.name: Psychic Citadel
rules.description: Build a mental fortress whose strength grows with your Force Adept training.

mechanics.effect: Gain a Force bonus to Will Defense equal to your Force Adept class level.

rules.name: Psychic Defenses
rules.description: Mind-affecting Force powers aimed at you lash back against their user.

mechanics.trigger: Another creature targets you with a Force power bearing the mind-affecting descriptor.
mechanics.effect: That creature automatically takes Force damage equal to 1d6 times your Wisdom modifier, minimum 1d6.

rules.name: Pursuit
rules.description: Excel at forcing another vehicle into a dogfight.

mechanics.trigger: Make a Pilot check to initiate a dogfight.
mechanics.effect: Roll twice and keep the better result.

rules.name: Quick Modification
rules.description: Exchange one accessory on a lightsaber you built in only a minute.

mechanics.use: Spend 1 minute working on a lightsaber you built.
mechanics.effect: Remove one accessory and install a different accessory.
mechanics.special: The GM may rule rare-material or difficult modifications, such as electrum detail, cannot be exchanged this way.

rules.name: Quick Trigger
rules.description: Fire at a vehicle as it leaves close weapon range.

mechanics.trigger: An enemy vehicle leaves your square or an adjacent square.
mechanics.effect: Make one attack against that vehicle.

rules.name: Quickseeing
rules.description: Sacrifice a Farseeing use to gain brief combat insight against a nearby living creature.

special: Membership in the Luka Sene tradition

mechanics.cost: Remove one Farseeing use from your active Force suite as though activated.
mechanics.target: One living creature within 12 squares.
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: On success, gain +2 insight on attacks against that target.
mechanics.duration: Until end of your turn.
mechanics.special: Counts as using Farseeing on the target but replaces the power's normal rules and effect.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 60

rules.name: Rally
rules.description: Rally badly wounded allies with defensive and damage bonuses.

mechanics.target: Visible allies below half maximum hit points.
mechanics.effect: Grant +2 morale to Reflex and Will Defenses and +2 on damage rolls.
mechanics.duration: Remainder of encounter.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; cannot benefit yourself. Can affect allied vehicles below half HP: +2 vehicle Reflex, +2 crew Will aboard it, and +2 vehicle-weapon damage before multiplier.

rules.name: Ranged Disarm
rules.description: Attempt to disarm with a ranged weapon without risking retaliation.

mechanics.effect: You may make disarm attempts using ranged attacks. A failed ranged disarm does not grant the opponent the normal free attack against you.

rules.name: Rapid Alchemy
rules.description: Briefly alter a melee weapon to improve its accuracy or empower one damaging strike.

mechanics.target: One melee weapon you wield.
mechanics.effect: Gain +2 equipment bonus on attacks with it for the encounter. Once during that encounter, sacrifice this bonus as a free action for +5 equipment bonus on one damage roll with it.

rules.name: Reactionary Attack
rules.description: Direct an ally to immediately counterattack someone who attacks your side.

mechanics.trigger: An enemy attacks you or an ally.
mechanics.target: One ally within 6 squares able to attack the triggering enemy.
mechanics.effect: The chosen ally immediately makes one attack against that enemy as a reaction.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 26

rules.name: Rebuke the Dark
rules.description: Rebuke Force powers carrying the dark-side descriptor more reliably.

mechanics.trigger: Use Rebuke against a Force power with the dark-side descriptor.
mechanics.effect: Roll the Rebuke Use the Force check twice and keep the better result.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Redirect Shot
rules.description: Redirect one successfully deflected blaster bolt toward another target.

mechanics.use: Immediate ranged attack, once per round.
mechanics.trigger: You successfully Deflect a single blaster bolt.
mechanics.target: Another target in line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Make a ranged attack with normal range penalties measured from you; on hit deal the original weapon's normal damage.
mechanics.special: Cannot redirect autofire barrages or non-blaster projectiles.

rules.name: Regimen Aptitude
rules.description: Perform learned Force regimens with exceptional consistency.

mechanics.effect: Gain +5 Force bonus on skill checks made to perform a Force regimen.

rules.name: Relentless
rules.description: Your designated quarry cannot force you down the condition track.

mechanics.target: The opponent designated by Hunter's Target.
mechanics.effect: Attacks and effects originating from that target do not move you down the condition track; damage and other effects still apply.

rules.name: Renew Vision
rules.description: Recover every spent copy of Farseeing once each encounter.

mechanics.effect: Return all expended uses of Farseeing to your active Force suite.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 25

rules.name: Resilience
rules.description: Spend a full round recovering two condition steps.

mechanics.effect: Move +2 steps toward normal on the condition track.
mechanics.special: Persistent-condition restrictions still apply.

rules.name: Resist the Dark Side
rules.description: Gain strong defenses against dark-side powers and fully corrupted Force-users.

mechanics.effect: Gain +5 Force bonus to all Defenses against powers with the dark-side descriptor and powers used by a Force-user whose Dark Side Score equals Wisdom.

rules.name: Revenge
rules.description: An equal- or higher-level ally falling fuels your attacks.

mechanics.trigger: An ally of your level or higher is killed or reduced to 0 hit points in your line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Gain +2 Force bonus on attack and damage rolls.
mechanics.duration: Until encounter end.
mechanics.special: Multiple triggers do not stack.

rules.name: Riposte
rules.description: Counterattack after successfully Blocking a melee blow.

mechanics.trigger: You negate a non-area melee attack with Block.
mechanics.effect: Make one lightsaber attack against the creature whose attack you negated.
mechanics.special: Cannot trigger from Blocking melee area damage.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 25

rules.name: Ruthless Negotiator
rules.description: Negotiate bounty payments with intimidating confidence.

mechanics.trigger: Make Persuasion to haggle over a bounty's price.
mechanics.effect: Roll twice and keep the better result.

rules.name: Second Skin
rules.description: Increase both defensive bonuses supplied by proficient armor.

mechanics.effect: Increase the armor bonus to Reflex Defense and equipment bonus to Fortitude Defense by 1 each.
mechanics.special: You must be proficient with the armor worn.

rules.name: Sense Deception
rules.description: Replace Will Defense with a stronger Use the Force result against lies or influence.

mechanics.trigger: A Deception or Persuasion check targets your Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: Make a Use the Force check and use its result in place of Will Defense if higher.

rules.name: Sentinel Strike
rules.description: Deal extra damage to defensively compromised enemies with a lightsaber or non-dark Force power.

mechanics.trigger: Hit a flat-footed enemy, or one denied Dexterity to Reflex against you, with a lightsaber attack or damage-dealing Force power.
mechanics.effect: Deal +1d6 damage per selection.
mechanics.special: Does not apply to dark-side powers. Repeatable to maximum +5d6.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 25

rules.name: Sentinel's Gambit
rules.description: Exploit a nearby dark-side enemy's defenses.

mechanics.target: One adjacent enemy you know has Dark Side Score 1+.
mechanics.effect: Target loses its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense against your attacks.
mechanics.duration: Until end of your next turn.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 25

rules.name: Severing Strike
rules.description: Choose maiming restraint instead of killing a target with an overwhelming lightsaber strike.

mechanics.trigger: Lightsaber damage equals or exceeds both the target's current hit points and damage threshold.
mechanics.effect: Deal half damage, move target -1 condition step, and sever one arm at wrist/elbow or one leg at knee/ankle.
mechanics.special: Arm loss prevents use of that hand and imposes -5 on Strength- and Dexterity-based checks. Leg loss knocks prone, halves speed and carrying capacity, and imposes the same -5. The persistent condition requires successful surgery; a cybernetic replacement removes these penalties.

rules.name: Share Force Secret
rules.description: Briefly teach one of your Force secrets to a nearby trained ally.

special: Know at least one Force secret

mechanics.selection: Choose one Force secret you know when taking this talent.
mechanics.target: One Use the Force-trained ally within 12 squares.
mechanics.effect: The ally gains that secret's benefit until the end of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Select again to share a different known secret.

rules.name: Share Force Technique
rules.description: Briefly teach one of your Force techniques to a nearby trained ally.

special: Know at least one Force technique

mechanics.selection: Choose one known Force technique other than Force Point Recovery.
mechanics.target: One Use the Force-trained ally within 12 squares.
mechanics.effect: The ally gains that technique's benefit until the end of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Select again to share a different known technique.

rules.name: Share Talent
rules.description: Teach allies one of your lightsaber talents for the remainder of an encounter.
choices: Owned Lightsaber Combat, Duelist, or Lightsaber Forms talent

special: Possess at least one talent from Lightsaber Combat, Duelist, or Lightsaber Forms

mechanics.selection: Choose one owned talent from one of the permitted trees.
mechanics.use: Standard action, once per day for the selected talent; spend 1 Force Point.
mechanics.target: Up to half your Jedi Knight class level in Use the Force-trained allies within 12 squares who can see and hear you.
mechanics.effect: Each target gains the chosen talent through encounter end even without meeting its prerequisites.
mechanics.special: Select again for a different talent; each selected talent can be shared once per day.

rules.name: Shared Notoriety
rules.description: Minions invoke your name to make their threats more reliable.

mechanics.trigger: One of your minions invokes your name while making Persuasion to intimidate.
mechanics.effect: The minion may reroll but must keep the second result.

rules.name: Sheltering Stance
rules.description: Protect an adjacent ally with Block or Deflect without spending a Force Point.

mechanics.trigger: An attack targets an adjacent ally and is eligible for your Block or Deflect talent.
mechanics.effect: You may use Block or Deflect to protect that ally without paying the normal Force Point cost for defending another character.
mechanics.special: All other Block or Deflect requirements and cumulative penalties apply.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 40

rules.name: Shield Expert
rules.description: Recharge an active personal energy shield during combat.

mechanics.target: Your active personal shield.
mechanics.effect: Restore 10 points of Shield Rating, up to the shield's normal maximum.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 29

rules.name: Shien
rules.description: Redirect deflected blaster bolts with exceptional accuracy.

mechanics.trigger: Use Redirect Shot after deflecting a blaster bolt.
mechanics.effect: Gain +5 on the redirected ranged attack roll.

rules.name: Shift Defense I
rules.description: Trade a penalty to one defense for a small bonus to another.

mechanics.effect: Take -2 to one of Reflex, Fortitude, or Will and gain +1 competence to a different defense.
mechanics.duration: Until start of your next turn.

rules.name: Shift Defense II
rules.description: Make a larger defensive trade between two defenses.

mechanics.effect: Take -5 to one defense and gain +2 competence to a different defense.
mechanics.duration: Until start of your next turn.

rules.name: Shift Defense III
rules.description: Concentrate defense heavily in one area at the expense of the other two.

mechanics.effect: Gain +5 competence to one defense and take -5 to each of the other two defenses.
mechanics.duration: Until start of your next turn.

rules.name: Shii-Cho
rules.description: Reduce the cumulative penalty for repeatedly blocking or deflecting attacks.

mechanics.effect: Each previous Block or Deflect attempt since the start of your last turn imposes -2 on later checks instead of -5.

rules.name: Shoto Focus
rules.description: Fight more accurately with a shoto paired with a standard one-handed lightsaber.

special: Wield both a one-handed lightsaber and a shoto or guard shoto

mechanics.effect: Gain +2 competence bonus on attacks made with the shoto or guard shoto while wielding the pair.

rules.name: Shoto Master
rules.description: Use a shoto pairing to improve dual-weapon handling and accelerate Lightsaber Defense.

special: Wield a one-handed lightsaber and a shoto or guard shoto

mechanics.effect: Treat the one-handed lightsaber as a light weapon while wielding the pair. If you possess Lightsaber Defense, activate it as a free action on your turn rather than a swift action while using the pair.

rules.name: Shoto Pin
rules.description: Pin an adjacent attacker's weapon after blocking it with a shoto.

mechanics.trigger: Successfully use Block to negate an adjacent creature's melee attack while wielding a shoto.
mechanics.effect: The attacker cannot make further melee attacks until the start of its next turn or until you are no longer adjacent.

rules.name: Single Weapon Flourish I
rules.description: Move freely during a full attack made with one light weapon.

feats: Double Attack (Advanced Melee, Exotic Melee, or Lightsabers)

mechanics.trigger: Make a full attack while wielding only one light melee weapon or one lightsaber.
mechanics.effect: Move up to your speed as a free action at any point during your turn.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 47

rules.name: Single Weapon Flourish II
rules.description: Make a single-weapon full attack as a standard action.

feats: Double Attack (Advanced Melee, Exotic Melee, or Lightsabers)

mechanics.trigger: Wield only one light melee weapon or one lightsaber.
mechanics.effect: Make a full attack instead of spending a full-round action.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 47

rules.name: Sith Alchemy
rules.description: Create Sith amulets, dark armor, offensive talismans, and alchemically treated Sith weapons.

mechanics.cost: Each transformation increases Dark Side Score by 1 and normally requires a Force Point.
mechanics.amulet: Spend 25,000 credits in materials and one week of work, then 1 Force Point, to create a Sith amulet.
mechanics.armor: Transform battle armor into matching light, medium, or heavy dark armor in 1/2/3 days; spend a Force Point at completion.
mechanics.talisman: Full-round action and 1 Force Point creates a carried talisman adding +1d6 damage to damaging Force powers. Only one active; after destruction, wait 24 hours.
mechanics.weapon: Spend 1 hour and 1 Force Point treating a simple or advanced melee weapon. Lightsabers no longer ignore its DR; proficient users may use it with Block, Deflect, Redirect Shot, and their prerequisites. Its wielder may spend a Force Point as a swift action to add Dark Side Score to the next damage roll that encounter, increasing Dark Side Score by 1.

rules.name: Sith Alchemy Specialist
rules.description: Add a specialized alchemical trait to dark armor, a Sith abomination, or a Sith weapon.

mechanics.use: Spend 1 uninterrupted hour and 1 Force Point; increase Dark Side Score by 1.
mechanics.effect: Apply one eligible trait: armor may gain cortosis weave, +2 dark-side Use the Force, +2 stealth Use the Force, or +2 intimidation; an abomination may gain DR 5/increase DR 5, +2 Will, or poisoned natural weapons; a Sith weapon may inflict delayed 1d4 damage, grant +2 Block/Deflect, or remain Sith-poisoned.
mechanics.special: Only one modification at a time and normally one trait per object; the same benefit cannot stack with itself.

rules.name: Skilled Advisor
rules.description: Spend a round advising an ally to grant a large skill bonus.

mechanics.target: One willing ally able to hear and understand you.
mechanics.effect: Grant +5 on the ally's next skill check; spend a Force Point to make it +10.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; cannot advise yourself.

rules.name: Skirmisher
rules.description: Moving before attacking improves accuracy.

mechanics.trigger: Before attacking, move at least 2 squares and finish in a different square from where you started.
mechanics.effect: Gain +1 on attack rolls.
mechanics.duration: Until the start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: With vehicle weapons, only the pilot can gain this benefit.

rules.name: Slashing Charge
rules.description: Block attacks and make Riposte counterattacks while charging without escalating Block penalties.

mechanics.use: Declare during a charge before your first Riposte; once per encounter.
mechanics.effect: During that charge, Block attempts do not suffer the cumulative Use the Force penalty from earlier Block attempts made during the charge. Apply the charge attack bonus to every Riposte attack made during it.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Sneak Attack
rules.description: Deal extra damage to a flat-footed enemy or one denied Dexterity to Reflex.

mechanics.trigger: A melee or ranged attack hits an opponent that is flat-footed or denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex.
mechanics.effect: Deal +1d6 damage per selection.
mechanics.special: Ranged Sneak Attack requires the target within 6 squares. Repeatable to a maximum +10d6.

rules.name: Sokan
rules.description: Tumble through threatened spaces with reliable economy of movement.

mechanics.effect: You may take 10 on Acrobatics checks to tumble even while threatened. Each threatened or occupied square tumbled through counts as only 1 square of movement.

rules.name: Soothing Presence
rules.description: Wild beasts instinctively become less hostile when encountering you.

mechanics.trigger: Encounter a beast with an unfriendly attitude toward you.
mechanics.effect: Its attitude automatically becomes indifferent without a check.

rules.name: Soresu
rules.description: Retry a failed lightsaber defense against melee or ranged attacks.

mechanics.trigger: Fail a Use the Force check for Block or Deflect.
mechanics.effect: Reroll the failed check under the same circumstances.

rules.name: Spacehound
rules.description: Operate naturally in low gravity, ignore space sickness, and use starship weapons proficiently.

mechanics.effect: Take no low- or zero-gravity attack penalty, ignore space sickness, and count as proficient with every starship weapon.

rules.name: Spontaneous Skill
rules.description: Temporarily treat one untrained skill check as trained.

mechanics.trigger: You make a check with a skill in which you are not trained.
mechanics.effect: Resolve that check as though trained, allowing trained-only uses.
mechanics.special: Use the Force requires Force Sensitivity. Repeatable; each selection adds one daily use.

rules.name: Sprint
rules.description: Run five times your speed.

mechanics.trigger: You use the run action.
mechanics.effect: Move up to 5 × speed instead of the normal 4 × speed.

rules.name: Starship Raider
rules.description: Attack more accurately while aboard a starship.

mechanics.effect: Gain +1 on attack rolls while aboard a starship, with both personal and starship weapons.

rules.name: Stellar Warrior
rules.description: A natural 20 aboard a starship grants a temporary Force Point.

mechanics.trigger: Roll a natural 20 on an attack made aboard a starship.
mechanics.effect: Gain 1 temporary Force Point.
mechanics.duration: Unused point disappears at encounter end.
mechanics.special: Works with personal and vehicle weapons aboard a starship.

rules.name: Stunning Strike
rules.description: Threshold-breaking melee damage worsens the target's condition by an additional step.

mechanics.trigger: Your melee damage equals or exceeds the target's Damage Threshold.
mechanics.effect: Move the target one additional step down the condition track.

rules.name: Suppress Force
rules.description: Spend Mind Trick reactively to convince another Force-user that its connection has failed.

mechanics.use: Reaction; expend one Mind Trick use.
mechanics.target: One Intelligence 3+ creature within 12 squares and line of sight attempting Use the Force.
mechanics.check: Your Use the Force vs. the target's Use the Force result.
mechanics.effect: On success, negate the target's check and the action it was attempting fails.

rules.name: Surefooted
rules.description: Move through difficult terrain without reduced speed.

mechanics.effect: Difficult terrain does not reduce your speed.
mechanics.special: Other terrain effects besides speed reduction still apply.

rules.name: Swift Power
rules.description: Use one standard- or move-action Force power as a swift action.

mechanics.effect: Activate a Force power that normally requires a standard or move action as a swift action.

rules.name: System Hit
rules.description: Damage vehicle systems more severely when a hit exceeds threshold.

mechanics.trigger: Your attack damages a vehicle for at least its damage threshold.
mechanics.effect: Move the vehicle one additional step down the condition track beyond the normal threshold effect.

rules.name: Tactical Edge
rules.description: Issue several common tactical directives more quickly.

mechanics.effect: You may activate Assault Tactics, Deployment Tactics, or Field Tactics as a swift action instead of a move action, provided you possess the talent used.

rules.name: Taint of the Dark Side
rules.description: Learn one dark-side Force power and use it sparingly without increasing your Dark Side Score.

mechanics.effect: Add one Force power with the dark-side descriptor to your Force suite. Once per encounter, you may use that power without increasing your Dark Side Score.
mechanics.special: Other uses of that power follow the normal Dark Side Score rules.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Telekinetic Power
rules.description: A natural 20 with a telekinetic power lets you use it again immediately.

mechanics.trigger: Roll natural 20 on Use the Force to activate a telekinetic Force power.
mechanics.effect: Immediately use that same power again as a free action against any eligible target.

rules.name: Telekinetic Savant
rules.description: Recover an expended telekinetic Force power without a Force Point.

mechanics.use: Swift action, once per encounter per selection.
mechanics.effect: Return one spent telekinetic Force power to your active suite without spending a Force Point.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for another use each encounter.

rules.name: Telepathic Influence
rules.description: Give an ally a temporary Force Point when you roll a natural 20.

mechanics.trigger: Roll a natural 20 on an attack roll or Use the Force check.
mechanics.target: One ally within 12 squares.
mechanics.effect: Instead of regaining all spent Force powers, grant the ally 1 temporary Force Point.
mechanics.duration: Unused point disappears at encounter end.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 53

rules.name: Telepathic Intruder
rules.description: Once you breach a mind, subsequent mental Force effects become easier to impose.

mechanics.trigger: Successfully affect a target with a mind-affecting Force power.
mechanics.effect: Gain +2 Force bonus on skill checks to activate mind-affecting Force powers and talents against that same target.
mechanics.duration: Until the end of your next turn.

rules.name: Telepathic Link
rules.description: Maintain a long-range mental link and share Force powers with one willing ally.

mechanics.use: Swift action to form; no action to end.
mechanics.target: One willing Force-sensitive ally.
mechanics.effect: Communicate telepathically within 1 kilometer. Once per encounter, with consent, either participant may use one power from the other's Force suite.
mechanics.duration: Until dismissed, range is exceeded, or another link is formed.
mechanics.special: Only one active link at a time.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 53

rules.name: Total Concealment
rules.description: Ordinary concealment becomes total concealment for you.

mechanics.trigger: A situation grants you concealment.
mechanics.effect: Treat that concealment as total concealment instead.

rules.name: Tough as Nails
rules.description: Gain another daily second wind.

mechanics.effect: Gain one additional second wind per day.
mechanics.special: With Extra Second Wind, the Core combination provides three daily uses; the once-per-encounter restriction remains.

rules.name: Trace
rules.description: Use network searches in place of conventional information gathering.

mechanics.trigger: You have access to a computer network and would make a Gather Information check.
mechanics.effect: Use your Use Computer modifier and make a Use Computer check instead.

rules.name: Trakata
rules.description: Exploit rapid lightsaber deactivation and ignition to feint in combat.

mechanics.use: Two swift actions while wielding a lightsaber.
mechanics.effect: Make a Deception check to feint in combat.

rules.name: Transfer Essence
rules.description: Manifest briefly as a dark spirit after death and attempt to possess a creature or object.

special: Dark Side Score equals Wisdom score

mechanics.trigger: You die.
mechanics.effect: Become a dark spirit through encounter end. As a standard action, attack an adjacent creature's Will with Use the Force, dealing 8d6 stun; reducing it to 0 hp or the bottom condition step permits possession. Alternatively enter an adjacent object and attempt possession when someone uses it.
mechanics.duration: If no creature or object is possessed within 10 rounds, the spirit dissipates.

rules.name: Transfer Power
rules.description: Move one available Force power use from your suite into an ally's suite.

mechanics.use: Standard action; expend one available Force power use.
mechanics.target: One Use the Force-trained ally within 12 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Add one use of that power to the ally's suite.
mechanics.duration: The granted use disappears when activated; if unused, it is permanently removed from the ally's suite at encounter end.

rules.name: Trigger Work
rules.description: Use Rapid Shot without its normal attack penalty.

mechanics.trigger: Use Rapid Shot.
mechanics.effect: Take no attack-roll penalty from Rapid Shot; all other requirements and effects remain.

rules.name: Trust
rules.description: Give up your standard action so an ally gains another major action next turn.

mechanics.target: One ally in line of sight.
mechanics.effect: On its next turn, the ally gains one extra standard action or move action of its choice.
mechanics.special: The granted action remains even if line of sight is later broken. Mind-affecting; cannot target yourself.

rules.name: Twin Weapon Mastery
rules.description: Reposition safely between the attacks granted by Twin Weapon Style.

mechanics.trigger: Use Twin Weapon Style.
mechanics.effect: Move up to 2 squares between its attacks without provoking attacks of opportunity.

rules.name: Twin Weapon Style
rules.description: Attack two different enemies with paired weapons as a standard action.

special: Wield two weapons or a double weapon

mechanics.effect: Make one attack with each weapon, or each end of a double weapon; the attacks must target different creatures.

rules.name: Unbalance Opponent
rules.description: Deny one nearby-sized opponent its Strength bonus when it attacks you.

mechanics.use: Designate one opponent during your turn; may choose a new one on a later turn.
mechanics.target: An opponent no more than one size category larger or smaller than you.
mechanics.effect: The opponent cannot add a positive Strength modifier to attack rolls against you.
mechanics.special: A Strength penalty still applies, and Strength modifies damage normally.

rules.name: Uncanny Dodge I
rules.description: Retain Dexterity to Reflex while flat-footed or attacked from hiding.

mechanics.effect: Do not lose your Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense because you are flat-footed or struck by a hidden attacker.
mechanics.special: You still lose Dexterity to Reflex while immobilized. If you are a vehicle's pilot, the benefit applies to that vehicle.

rules.name: Uncanny Dodge II
rules.description: You cannot be flanked.

mechanics.effect: Opponents on opposite sides do not gain flanking benefits against you.
mechanics.special: If you are a vehicle's pilot, the benefit applies to that vehicle.

rules.name: Unclouded Judgment
rules.description: Spend a Force Point to reject a mind-affecting Force power or talent automatically.

mechanics.trigger: You are targeted by a mind-affecting Force power or talent.
mechanics.effect: Negate that power or talent's effects on you without a check.

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: Reduce the condition-track movement caused by one debilitating hit.

mechanics.trigger: An attack hits and would move you down the condition track.
mechanics.effect: Reduce the number of condition steps moved by 1, minimum 0. Damage and other effects resolve normally.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 45

rules.name: Vaapad
rules.description: Expand your lightsaber's critical threat range against foes you can still hit.

mechanics.effect: Lightsaber attacks score critical hits on natural 19 or 20.
mechanics.special: A natural 19 is not an automatic hit; if the attack still misses, it is not a critical hit.

rules.name: Vehicular Evasion
rules.description: Use evasive piloting to reduce or avoid area-attack damage.

mechanics.trigger: A functioning vehicle you pilot is targeted by an area attack.
mechanics.effect: On a hit, the vehicle takes half damage; on a miss, it takes no damage.
mechanics.special: Cannot be used while the vehicle is stationary or disabled.

rules.name: Vigilance
rules.description: Maintain a protective stance that reinforces one adjacent ally's Reflex Defense.

mechanics.use: Swift action to designate or change the target.
mechanics.target: One adjacent ally.
mechanics.effect: Target gains +1 deflection to Reflex Defense.
mechanics.duration: While you remain adjacent to that ally or until you designate another.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 40

rules.name: Visionary Attack
rules.description: Use a Farseeing vision to let a nearby attacker reroll a miss.

mechanics.use: Reaction after you or an ally within 12 squares misses.
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. missed attack target's Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: On success, attacker rerolls the missed attack.
mechanics.duration: You take cumulative -5 on Use the Force checks until start of your next turn each time used.
mechanics.special: One use per attack; counts as Farseeing against the target and replaces its normal effect.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 24

rules.name: Visionary Defense
rules.description: Use Farseeing to protect a nearby target from an incoming attack.

mechanics.use: Reaction after an attack is declared against you or an ally within 12 squares, before its result is known.
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. attacker's Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: On success, target gains +5 Force bonus to Reflex Defense against that attack.
mechanics.duration: You take cumulative -5 on Use the Force checks until start of your next turn each time used.
mechanics.special: One use per attack; counts as Farseeing against attacker and replaces normal effect.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 25

rules.name: Visions
rules.description: Use Farseeing to view a target's past or possible future.

mechanics.effect: View the target up to 1 year per character level into its past or future rather than present circumstances.
mechanics.special: Future information is mutable if later choices alter events.

rules.name: Vital Encouragement
rules.description: Your guardian urges you onward with a reserve of temporary vitality.

mechanics.effect: Gain bonus hit points equal to 10 + half heroic level; damage removes these first.
mechanics.duration: Unused bonus hit points disappear after the encounter.

rules.name: Walk the Line
rules.description: Momentarily reduce the Defenses of nearby visible opponents.

mechanics.target: Every opponent within 6 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Targets take -2 to all Defenses.
mechanics.duration: Until the start of your next turn; ends for a target if line of sight is broken.
mechanics.special: Range is 6 squares at starship scale when applicable.

rules.name: WatchCircle Initiate
rules.description: Transfer one of your ordinary Force Points to an ally through Farseeing.

mechanics.cost: Expend one active Farseeing use and subtract 1 non-temporary Force Point from your total; this is not treated as spending a Force Point.
mechanics.target: One ally in line of sight.
mechanics.check: Use the Force DC 15.
mechanics.effect: On success, add 1 Force Point to the ally's total.
mechanics.special: Counts as using Farseeing against that ally but replaces its normal effect.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 25

rules.name: Watchman's Advance
rules.description: Grant your entire side extra movement during a surprise round.

mechanics.trigger: You act during a surprise round.
mechanics.target: You and your allies.
mechanics.effect: Each target may take one extra move action during that surprise round.
mechanics.special: A character can gain only one extra move action this way regardless of how many allied Jedi possess this talent.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 40

rules.name: Waveform
rules.description: Shape environmental particles like an ocean wave to strengthen telekinetic damage.

special: Membership in the Order of Shasa

mechanics.use: Swift action when activating a telekinetic Force power.
mechanics.trigger: Use a power affected by Telekinetic Power or Telekinetic Savant.
mechanics.effect: Add Charisma modifier, minimum +1, to any damage the power deals.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 61

rules.name: Weak Point
rules.description: Briefly ignore one target's Damage Reduction.

mechanics.target: One target in line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Your attacks ignore that target's Damage Reduction.
mechanics.duration: Through the end of your next turn.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 28

rules.name: Weaken Resolve
rules.description: A threshold-breaking attack can terrify a weaker enemy into fleeing.

mechanics.trigger: You deal damage equal to or greater than the target's Damage Threshold.
mechanics.check: Persuasion vs. Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: A lower-level target flees from you at top speed and cannot take standard, swift, or full-round actions.
mechanics.duration: 1 minute, ending early if the target is wounded.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting. Equal- or higher-level targets are immune. Target may spend a Force Point as a free action or reaction to negate it. Can affect a hailed vehicle through its commander after threshold damage; higher-CL vehicles are immune.

rules.name: Wealth
rules.description: Receive a substantial recurring income based on Noble class levels.

mechanics.trigger: Each time you gain a character level, including the level at which this talent is selected.
mechanics.effect: Receive credits equal to 5,000 × your current Noble class level.
mechanics.special: Funds appear in an accessible civilized location or bank account of your choice.

rules.name: Weapon Specialization
rules.description: Deal additional damage with a selected weapon family.

feats: Weapon Focus (selected weapon or weapon group)
special: Proficient with selected weapon or group

mechanics.effect: Gain +2 damage with the selected exotic weapon or weapon group.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for different selections. Heavy Weapons selection applies to vehicle weapon attacks.

rules.name: Weapon Specialization (Lightsabers)
rules.description: Deal additional melee damage with lightsabers.

mechanics.effect: Gain +2 on melee damage rolls with lightsabers.

rules.name: Wicked Strike
rules.description: Turn a lightsaber critical into a severe condition-track penalty.

mechanics.use: Free action on a critical hit.
mechanics.trigger: Score a critical hit with a lightsaber.
mechanics.effect: Move the target -2 steps on the condition track in addition to resolving the critical hit.

rules.name: Wild Sense
rules.description: Borrow a nearby friendly beast's perceptions and line of sight.

mechanics.target: One indifferent-or-better beast within 12 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.effect: The beast immediately makes an active Perception check; you perceive everything it perceives and have line of sight to everything it sees until the end of your turn.
